title: AI Sales System Build (Revenue Command) — n8n + Retell AI + Twilio + CRM Integrations (Multi-Client SaaS)
description:
We run a sales and AI systems consultancy in Australia. We've already built and proven an AI sales stack for our own business — conversational SMS agents, AI voice agents, automated pipeline management and a live revenue dashboard. It works. It's producing real bookings and real revenue right now.



We're now productising it so we can deploy the same system to other sales-driven businesses: recruitment agencies, real estate agents, business brokers and similar.



We need one developer to build the productised, multi-client version. You are not inventing this from scratch — the logic, the sequences, the prompts and the workflows already exist and are running. Your job is to rebuild them properly as a repeatable, multi-tenant system that we can deploy to a new client in under a week instead of three.



What you'd be building



A four-layer system, deployed per client, managed from one place:



1. Daily briefing engine Automated morning brief and end-of-day close-out delivered to the client 
 + SMS + dashboard). Pulls from their CRM and calendar: what's booked today, who went quiet, who's due for follow-up, what moved yesterday, what needs a human. Not a data dump — a prioritised, written brief.



2. Conversational SMS agent Two-way AI SMS that qualifies inbound enquiries, books appointments, chases no-shows, nurtures cold leads and escalates to the human when the conversation needs it. Must handle real replies (not just broadcast), write back to the CRM, respect opt-outs, and know when to stop.



3. AI voice agent Outbound calling of new leads and enquiries using Retell AI over Twilio, with an Australian SIP trunk. Batch campaigns plus real-time speed-to-lead calling. Call outcomes, transcripts and dispositions sync back to the CRM. Books directly into the client's calendar.



4. Client dashboard A web dashboard where the client sees their pipeline, lead flow, agent activity, conversion rates by stage, and ROI (what the system cost vs what it produced). Login per client. This is the thing they open every morning — it needs to be genuinely good, not a wall of numbers.



Plus: a provisioning layer so onboarding a new client is configuration, not development.



Integrations required

CRM: HubSpot and GoHighLevel at minimum. Pipedrive and Salesforce as fast-follows. Must be built behind an abstraction layer — we will add CRMs and we do not want to rewrite the agents each time.

Calendar: Google Calendar, cal.com, Calendly




: Gmail / Google Workspace, Microsoft 365

Telephony: Twilio (Australian AU1 region), Retell AI

LLM: your recommendation — we care about cost per conversation, not brand names

Tech stack



Our current production stack is Make.com + Retell AI + Twilio + HubSpot. For this build we expect to move the automation layer to self-hosted n8n for cost and multi-tenancy reasons — but if you can make a strong case for a different approach, we want to hear it in your proposal. Tell us what you'd actually do and why.



For the dashboard, we're open on the stack. Something you can maintain, that we can hire for later.



Milestones

# Milestone Deliverable Est. hours

1 Foundation Multi-tenant automation infrastructure, client config layer, credential/secrets handling, logging and error alerting. One test client provisioned end to end. ~140

2 Integrations CRM, calendar and
 connectors behind a common abstraction. Two-way sync verified against a live sandbox. ~110

3 SMS agent Conversational agent live: inbound reply handling, qualification, booking, escalation, opt-out compliance, full CRM write-back. ~100

4 Voice agent Retell + Twilio AU trunk live. Batch dialler + speed-to-lead trigger. Outcomes, transcripts and recordings synced. Calendar booking from call. ~100

5 Briefing engine Morning brief + daily close-out generating and delivering reliably for the test client. ~55

6 Dashboard Client-facing dashboard, authenticated, live data, ROI reporting. ~150

7 Provisioning + handover New-client setup tooling, templates, documentation, video walkthrough, 30 days of bug support. ~60



~715 hours core + ~15% QA/revision allowance.



Milestones are paid on acceptance. We'd like to start with Milestone 1 as a standalone engagement — if it goes well, the rest follows without re-negotiation.



What we need from you

Demonstrated production work with AI voice agents — Retell, Vapi, Bland or similar. Not a tutorial project. Something real, with real call volume.

Demonstrated n8n or Make.com work at a level beyond simple linear automations — error handling, retries, queues, sub-workflows, multi-tenancy.

Twilio experience including SIP trunking and non-US number provisioning.

Real CRM API work — HubSpot or GoHighLevel specifically is a big plus.

Front-end capability for the dashboard, or a named partner you work with (tell us who, up front).

Written English good enough to work asynchronously across a 5–12 hour timezone gap.

You test your own work. We are not your QA team.

What we don't want

Anyone who has only ever built demos

Agencies who bid, win, then hand it to a junior — we want to talk to and work with the person doing the build

Anyone who needs a spec for every decision. We'll give you the logic and the outcomes; you own the technical calls.

Terms

All code, workflows and IP assigned to us on payment. NDA before we share our existing prompts, sequences and workflow logic.

Weekly 30-minute call at a time that works for both of us, plus async updates.

We supply all accounts, API keys and test data.

Ongoing retainer available after handover for maintenance and new client onboarding — this is the outcome we're hoping for.

Screening questions (put these in the Upwork job form)

Link us to an AI voice agent you have built that has handled real calls at volume. What was the call volume, and what was the connect-to-booking rate?

We're planning to move from Make.com to self-hosted n8n for multi-tenancy and cost. Do you agree with that call? If not, what would you do instead and why?

How would you architect this so that onboarding client #40 takes a few hours of configuration rather than a few days of development? Be specific.

What's your realistic all-in cost per connected AI call minute for a call to an Australian mobile, and how would you bring it down?

What hours do you work, in UTC?

Paid test task (do this before you award the full project)

title: Book Keeper
description:
Bookkeeper – Australian Barber Shop



About the role



We are a small Australian barber shop looking for an experienced bookkeeper to manage our monthly bookkeeping, reconciliation and Australian tax reporting requirements.



This is a small ongoing role of approximately 3-4 hours per month, or more at the end of each Qtr..



We are looking for someone with strong practical experience working with Australian businesses and a detailed understanding of Australian Taxation Office (ATO) requirements, GST, BAS, PAYG and superannuation.



The main purpose of the role is to ensure our accounts are fully reconciled each month, our financial records are accurate and all information required for our Australian tax and ATO reporting is correctly prepared and ready for lodgement.

The business owner will review and lodge the BAS.



Key responsibilities

* Complete monthly bank and account reconciliations

* Review all transactions for accuracy and correct allocation

* Ensure Xero is fully reconciled and up to date

* Identify and resolve discrepancies, errors or unusual transactions

* Maintain accurate bookkeeping records

* Prepare monthly financial reports

* Prepare all information required for BAS and GST reporting

* Calculate and reconcile GST figures

* Prepare information required for PAYG reporting

* Ensure superannuation-related transactions are correctly recorded

* Maintain receipts, invoices and supporting documentation through Hubdoc

* Ensure Xero and Hubdoc records are complete and accurate

* Review the accounts before each BAS period and flag any issues requiring attention

* Provide the business owner with the completed BAS figures and supporting information for review and lodgement

* Liaise with the business owner regarding any discrepancies or information required

* Work with our Australian accountant/tax adviser where required



Australian tax and ATO knowledge



Strong practical knowledge of Australian bookkeeping and taxation requirements is essential.



Applicants should have demonstrated experience working with Australian businesses and be confident with:



* Australian Taxation Office (ATO) requirements

* GST

* BAS preparation

* PAYG withholding

* Superannuation

* Australian bookkeeping practices

* Australian small-business tax and compliance requirements



Applicants should be able to independently reconcile the accounts and prepare accurate BAS information for the business owner to review and lodge.



Software experience

Highly proficient experience with Xero and Hubdoc is essential.

You should be comfortable working independently within both systems and able to quickly identify and resolve discrepancies.



Payroll knowledge

Payroll processing is not part of the current role.

However, strong knowledge of Australian payroll is highly desirable.





The ideal candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

* Highly experienced in Australian bookkeeping

* Very familiar with Australian tax and ATO requirements

* Extremely accurate and detail-oriented

* Highly proficient in Xero and Hubdoc

* Comfortable working independently

* Reliable and able to meet monthly deadlines

* Proactive in identifying errors and discrepancies

* Comfortable communicating directly with the business owner

* Trustworthy and respectful of confidential financial information



Because this is only approx 3 hours of work each month, we are looking for someone who can work efficiently and independently without requiring ongoing supervision.



We are not looking for someone to simply enter transactions. We want someone who understands Australian bookkeeping and tax requirements, can review the accounts critically and can confidently tell us if something does not look right.

title: Zoho Books and Innago Setup Specialist,
description:
We are looking for an experienced Zoho Books and Innago Setup Specialist to automate our property management financial workflows. The ideal candidate will configure both platforms and establish a seamless integration so that income, expenses, and tenant transactions sync automatically between Innago and Zoho Books. Our goal is to achieve an end-to-end automated system that requires only minor, periodic oversight from our team.



Responsibilities:



Set up and configure Zoho Books and Innago for our property management operations.



Establish automatic sync for income, expenses, and transactions between both systems.



Ensure proper account categorization and reporting structure.



Conduct initial testing to verify data accuracy and minimal manual intervention

The successful candidate will establish and maintain reliable systems for recurring invoicing, payment tracking, account reminders, late notices, and digital recordkeeping.



Responsibilities will include preparing accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, annual budgets, and property-management performance reports. The candidate must also develop clear operating procedures, train management, and ensure the systems remain accurate, organized, secure, and fully operational.



Applicants must have demonstrated experience with Zoho Books, bookkeeping, and property-management operations. Strong attention to detail, accountability, confidentiality, and the ability to work independently are essential.



Regular camera-on WhatsApp video meetings and screen-sharing sessions are mandatory. Applicants who are unwilling or unable to communicate consistently by video should not apply.



This position will begin as a defined setup and financial catch-up project. Candidates who successfully complete the initial project may be considered for ongoing part-time responsibility for maintaining the company’s financial and property-management systems.

# Furniture Drafter & 3D Visualiser — Remote (Philippines)



**Full-time or part-time · Long-term · Work with an Australian furniture and interiors business**



---



## The role



We design furniture and interior products, and have them manufactured by factories in Vietnam and China. We need someone to turn concepts and reference photos into drawings those factories can quote from and build to — and to produce the 3D visuals we use to sell the finished pieces.

PLEASE ADVISE YOUR RATE

title: Real Estate Research & Lead Generation
description:
# Real Estate Research & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant



## Position Overview



We are looking for a sharp, resourceful, and highly motivated **Real Estate Research & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant** to help identify, research, qualify, and organize potential real estate and short-term rental leads.



This is **NOT a simple data-entry VA position**.



We are looking for someone who can investigate information, connect the dots between multiple sources, think critically, and take ownership of getting to the end result.



The ideal candidate is technically comfortable, analytical, fast-moving, organized, and willing to learn new tools and processes.





## Core Responsibilities



You will assist with research and lead-generation activities involving real estate properties, Airbnb/VRBO listings, property owners, and potential clients.



Responsibilities may include:



* Research Airbnb and VRBO listings based on specific criteria.

* Analyze listings, reviews, ratings, amenities, booking activity, and other property information.

* Identify potentially underperforming short-term rental properties.

* Perform **skip tracing** to identify property owners and available contact information.

* Research ownership information using public records and real estate databases.

* Use Zillow, Redfin, 
, county property records, and other listing or property-information services.

* Compare property photos, listing information, maps, parcel information, and other available data to help identify properties.

* Use **Google Reverse Image Search** and similar tools when appropriate.

* Organize research findings in Google Sheets.

* Verify information across multiple sources before entering results.

* Identify relationships between Airbnb/VRBO listings, property addresses, owners, LLCs, social media profiles, and other available information.

* Maintain accurate notes explaining how conclusions were reached.

* Assist with building and maintaining prospecting databases.

* Perform additional real estate research and lead-generation tasks as the business grows.



## Required Skills



### Research & Analytical Skills



You must have:



* Strong analytical and investigative skills.

* Ability to research information across multiple websites and databases.

* Ability to recognize patterns and connect information from different sources.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to verify information instead of simply accepting the first search result.

* Ability to work through incomplete information and determine the next logical research step.



We are specifically looking for someone who can **connect the dots and accomplish the goal**, rather than getting stuck whenever the answer is not immediately obvious.



### Technical Skills



You should be comfortable working with:



* Google Sheets

* Google Search

* Google Maps

* Google Reverse Image Search

* Airbnb

* VRBO

* Zillow

* Redfin

* 
 or similar real estate platforms

* Public property records

* Skip-tracing tools

* ChatGPT and other AI tools



Advanced Google Sheets knowledge is a plus, including:



* Filters

* Sorting

* Conditional formatting

* Data validation

* Basic formulas

* Removing duplicates

* Organizing large datasets



Experience with automation tools, scraping tools, CRM systems, AirDNA, PropStream, BatchLeads, Privy, REISift, or similar platforms is a major plus - but NOT required.





## Real Estate Knowledge



Previous experience in real estate is strongly preferred.



Helpful backgrounds include:



* Real estate virtual assistant

* Real estate lead generation

* Property research

* Skip tracing

* Short-term rentals

* Airbnb/VRBO research

* Property management

* Real estate investing

* Wholesaling

* Acquisition research

* MLS or property-listing research



You do NOT need to know everything on day one. We WILL TRAIN the right candidate.



We are willing to train the right person who demonstrates strong intelligence, curiosity, work ethic, and the ability to learn quickly.





## Use of ChatGPT & AI



You should already be comfortable using ChatGPT.



We expect you to use AI as a productivity and research assistant when appropriate.



However, **copying an AI answer without verifying it is NOT acceptable**.



The goal is to combine AI, research tools, common sense, and human judgment to produce accurate results efficiently.





## What We Value Most



### Resourcefulness



When one method does not work, try another.



Do not immediately stop and say:



“I couldn't find it.”



Instead, think:



“What other information do I have, and where else can I look?”



### Speed With Accuracy



We do not expect reckless work.



We do expect someone who thinks quickly, understands the objective, and keeps moving toward the answer.



The ideal person does not need every small step explained before taking action.





### High Sense of Ownership



Ownership is extremely important in this role.



If you make a mistake:



**Own it. Fix it. Learn from it. Don't repeat it. Move on.**



We do not expect perfection.



We do expect honesty, accountability, and continuous improvement.



Do not hide mistakes or blame tools, websites, coworkers, or incomplete instructions.



Bring the issue forward and help solve it.



### Leadership



Although this position may begin as an individual contributor, we strongly value leadership ability.



A strong candidate should eventually be capable of:



* Improving processes

* Suggesting better research methods

* Creating SOPs

* Training other VAs

* Reviewing another researcher's work

* Identifying inefficiencies

* Helping build and manage a small research or lead-generation team



We are looking for someone who wants to become increasingly valuable to the organization rather than simply complete assigned tasks.



## Ideal Personality



You will probably succeed in this position if you are:



* Curious

* Analytical

* Technically comfortable

* Highly organized

* Persistent

* Fast learner

* Resourceful

* Self-directed

* Accountable

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable solving problems

* Comfortable being challenged

* Willing to learn from mistakes

* Interested in real estate and technology



You should enjoy situations where someone gives you a goal and you figure out **how to get there**.





## This Position Is NOT a Good Fit If You:



* Need extremely detailed instructions for every task.

* Give up quickly when information is difficult to find.

* Primarily want repetitive data-entry work.

* Frequently submit incomplete work without explaining what is missing.

* Copy information without verifying it.

* Are uncomfortable learning new technology.

* Avoid responsibility when mistakes occur.

* Need constant supervision to remain productive.



## Example Assignment



You may be given an assignment such as:



“Find Airbnb properties meeting these criteria, identify their likely physical addresses, research the property owners, locate publicly available contact information, and organize everything in a Google Sheet.”



You may need to use several different sources to complete the assignment.



We care about both the **final answer and the quality of the reasoning used to reach it.**



## Growth Opportunity



For the right person, this can grow well beyond a traditional VA position.



As our processes and lead-generation operation expand, there may be opportunities to become a:



* Senior Research VA

* Lead Generation Specialist

* Research Team Lead

* Operations Coordinator

* Real Estate Acquisition Research Manager



We want someone who is interested in learning the business and growing with the organization.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of regular bookkeeping and administrative tasks and become a dependable part of our team.



About the Role



The role will involve a combination of general administration, bookkeeping and accounting support.

A key part of the position is managing regular and recurring responsibilities. Once trained, you will be expected to keep track of your assigned daily, weekly and monthly tasks and complete them on schedule.

You will receive appropriate training on our procedures and systems, but we are looking for someone who can become increasingly independent as they become familiar with the role.

• Preparing daily reports of client updates

s and other correspondence

• Processing client payroll

• Maintaining client records and documentation

• Completing data entry and basic accounting tasks

• Following up outstanding information and administrative matters

• Maintaining internal checklists and recurring task schedules

• Assisting with other bookkeeping, accounting support and administrative tasks as required



Essential Requirements

• Have experience using Xero

• Have good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel

• Have bookkeeping, accounting support or relevant administrative experience

• Have strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy

• Have good written English and be comfortable preparing professional correspondence

• Be organised and capable of managing recurring deadlines independently

• Be comfortable learning new systems and procedures

• Have no criminal history

Experience with New Zealand accounting, payroll or Inland Revenue processes would be an advantage, but training can be provided to the right candidate.



Who We Are Looking For

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys recruiting, communicating with candidates, and building a strong candidate pipeline.

Manage and monitor our Indeed BT/RBT job postings

Review incoming applications and resumes

Identify candidates who meet our basic qualifications

Proactively search for qualified RBTs and Behavior Technicians

Contact potential candidates through appropriate recruiting platforms

Conduct initial candidate screening by phone or video

Ask candidates our predetermined screening questions

Evaluate candidates based on experience, availability, communication, and overall fit

Follow up consistently with candidates throughout the hiring process

Schedule qualified candidates for interviews with our Clinical Director

Maintain an organized candidate tracking spreadsheet

Keep detailed notes on each candidate and their stage in the hiring process

Build a pipeline of potential candidates even when we do not have an immediate opening

Help us identify additional recruiting sources and strategies

Follow up with candidates who have expressed interest but have not completed the hiring process

Who We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is:

Experienced in recruiting or talent acquisition

Comfortable sourcing candidates rather than simply waiting for applications

Excellent at written and verbal communication

Highly organized and detail-oriented

Proactive and able to work independently

Comfortable communicating with candidates professionally

Persistent with follow-ups without being overly aggressive

Comfortable using Indeed, LinkedIn, Google Sheets, and similar platforms

Able to identify strong candidates from resumes and conversations

Interested in learning about ABA and the qualifications we look for in BT/RBT candidates

Strongly Preferred

Experience recruiting for any of the following is a major plus:

ABA therapy

Healthcare

Behavioral health

Special education

Therapy services

Nursing/allied health

Childcare or education

We are not looking for someone who will simply post a job and wait for applications.

We want someone who can actively find qualified candidates and reach out to them.

For example, you may be expected to:

Search for experienced RBTs

Identify candidates who may be a good fit

Send personalized outreach messages

Follow up with interested candidates

Maintain a candidate pipeline

Continuously improve our recruiting process

title: Experienced Shopee Product Research & Listing Specialist
description:
We are a Japanese e-commerce company starting and scaling a Shopee Singapore store.



We are looking for an EXPERIENCED Shopee specialist — not a general data-entry VA.



Our first goal is to publish 500–1,000 competitive listings and generate sales as quickly as possible.



At the beginning, we especially value your Shopee experience and knowledge. We want someone who can not only perform the work, but also explain the research and listing methods that have worked for them.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Product Research

- Research products on Shopee Singapore

- Analyze Top Sales / Sold per Month

- Find successful sellers and their best-selling products

- Analyze seller information such as number of products, ratings, followers, shop age, and sales performance

- Identify products with strong sales potential



2. Amazon Japan Product Matching

- Find the exact same product on Amazon.co.jp

- Confirm that the Shopee product and Amazon product are identical

- Record Amazon URL / ASIN / price

- Help evaluate whether the product can be sold profitably on Shopee Singapore



3. Shopee Listing

- Create accurate Shopee listings

- Create optimized English titles and descriptions

- Select correct categories and attributes

- Set variations, prices, weight and shipping information

- Publish listings accurately and efficiently



4. Product Images

- Create/improve the main product image

- Experience with Canva or similar image tools is preferred

- Images should be suitable for Shopee and visually competitive



5. Documentation

This is very important.



We want you to document and explain your workflow, including:

- How you find products likely to sell

- How you identify good competitor stores

- How you decide whether a product is worth listing

- How you create Shopee product images

- How you create listings efficiently

- Any techniques or methods you have learned from your previous Shopee experience



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You MUST have actual experience with Shopee.



We strongly prefer candidates who have experience with:

- Shopee Singapore

- Shopee product research

- Shopee product listing

- Competitor/store research

- Finding best-selling products

- Amazon Japan or Japanese products

- Dropshipping or cross-border e-commerce

- Canva/product image creation



IMPORTANT



We are NOT looking for someone whose experience is only general data entry, Shopify, Amazon, or eBay.



Actual Shopee experience is important.



When applying, please answer these questions:



1. Which Shopee marketplaces have you worked on?

2. How long have you worked with Shopee?

3. Approximately how many Shopee products have you listed?

4. Have you done product research using Top Sales, Sold per Month, or competitor stores?

5. Please explain your Shopee product research process.

7. Have you worked with dropshipping or cross-border Shopee stores?

9. What tools do you use for product research, images, and listing?

10. What results did the Shopee stores you worked on achieve?



SHORT PAID TEST



Selected candidates will be invited to complete a paid practical test.



The test will involve researching products on Shopee Singapore, identifying matching products on Amazon Japan, explaining why you selected them, and preparing a sample Shopee listing.



We are willing to pay more for someone with strong, proven Shopee experience.



There is an opportunity for long-term work and potentially a leadership role as we expand the Shopee operation.

title: AI Content Production & Systems Virtual Assistant
description:
### Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity | 30-Day Paid Trial



I’m looking for a creative, organized, tech-savvy Virtual Assistant to help me build and manage multiple faceless social media content channels.



This is **not a traditional administrative VA position**.



I’m looking for someone who genuinely enjoys AI, social media, storytelling, content creation, and figuring out better ways to get things done.



You’ll initially work closely with me to learn my content style and production process. Over time, my goal is for you to independently take a content idea from **research → script → visual creation → video → final organized deliverable**.



An important part of this role will also be helping me **develop, document, and improve our content-production systems and SOPs** so that we can produce content efficiently and consistently.



## What You'll Help With



Your responsibilities may include:



* Researching interesting, viral, evergreen, and trending content ideas

* Researching competitors and successful content formats

* Writing and improving hooks and scripts using AI

* Fact-checking information before it is used in content

* Creating AI image prompts

* Generating AI images and video assets

* Turning images into AI video clips

* Creating AI voiceovers

* Editing short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

* Adding captions, sound effects, music, B-roll, and other retention-focused editing

* Creating thumbnails, covers, and simple graphics

* Organizing content files and assets

* Maintaining a content calendar

* Tracking content through the production process

* Repurposing content across platforms

* Documenting repeatable workflows and creating SOPs

* Testing new AI tools and recommending ways to improve our workflow



Eventually, I would like to be able to give you a topic or content direction and have you manage most of the production process independently.



## Tools



Experience with some of the following is strongly preferred:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Higgsfield

* OpenArt

* Kling

* Google Veo

* Runway

* Midjourney or other AI image generators

* ElevenLabs or other AI voice tools

* CapCut

* Canva

* Google Drive

* Google Docs/Sheets

* Notion, ClickUp, Trello, or similar project-management tools



**You do NOT need experience with every tool listed above.**



I'm much more interested in someone who understands AI-assisted content creation and can quickly learn new tools.



## The Person I'm Looking For



You may be a great fit if you:



* Have excellent written English

* Have strong visual judgment

* Understand what makes short-form content engaging

* Are comfortable experimenting with AI tools

* Can follow detailed instructions

* Can also figure things out independently

* Are highly organized

* Pay close attention to details

* Communicate clearly when something isn't working

* Can research solutions before immediately asking for help

* Are comfortable receiving constructive feedback

* Can reproduce an established visual/content style consistently

* Enjoy documenting processes and improving systems

* Are dependable with deadlines



I'm especially interested in candidates who have experience with **faceless TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, AI storytelling, YouTube automation, or AI-generated video content.**



## Hours



We will begin at approximately **10–15 hours per week**.



There is potential for additional hours and a long-term position as our content channels grow.



The schedule can be reasonably flexible, but communication and meeting agreed-upon deadlines are important.



## 30-Day Paid Trial



The position will begin with a **30-day paid trial period**.



During the trial, we'll evaluate:



* Quality of work

* Reliability

* Communication

* Attention to detail

* Creativity

* Ability to follow instructions

* Ability to learn new tools

* Ability to work independently

* Speed and efficiency

* Ability to document and improve workflows



The trial is also an opportunity for you to determine whether the position is a good fit for you.



Either party may end the working relationship during the trial period. All approved work completed through the termination date will be paid according to our agreed terms.



Successful candidates may be offered an ongoing part-time position after the trial.



## How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following questions in your application:



1. Tell me about your experience creating social media content, especially faceless or AI-generated content.



2. Which AI image and video generation tools have you personally used?



3. Which video editing software do you use most often?



4. Please send 2–3 examples of videos or content you personally created. Clearly explain which parts you created yourself.



5. Imagine I give you this topic:



**“A strange Florida law most people don't know exists.”**



Briefly explain how you would turn that idea into a 30–60 second faceless video.



6. Tell me about a process or workflow you have improved or documented in a previous role.



7. If an AI video generation tool keeps producing an incorrect or distorted result, what would you do before asking me for help?



8. What internet speed do you currently have?



9. What computer/device do you use for video editing?



10. How many hours per week are you currently available?



11. What hourly rate are you seeking?



12. What is your favorite AI tool right now, and why?



### IMPORTANT



At the very beginning of your application, write:



**“CONTENT SYSTEMS”**



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be reviewed.



I'm looking for someone who wants to grow with this project long-term. If you love AI, content creation, storytelling, organization, and building better systems, I'd love to hear from you.



Compensation



$4–$5 USD per hour, based on experience and demonstrated skill.



The position will begin at approximately 10–15 hours per week with a 30-day paid trial period.



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right person. As the role grows and you demonstrate the ability to independently manage more of the content-production workflow, there may be opportunities for additional hours and increased compensation.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter - US Market
description:
JOB TITLE: B2B Appointment Setter (Cold Calling) - US Market



Company: Pulse Marketing Collective

Type: Part-time, 2 to 2.5 hours per day, Monday to Friday

Hours: Must work during 9am to 5pm US Eastern. No weekends.

Salary: Base hourly rate plus a bonus for every booked meeting that shows up



ABOUT US



Pulse Marketing Collective builds AI-powered outbound systems for B2B

companies in the US. You will be calling business owners to book short

introductory meetings with our team.



You are NOT selling anything on the phone. Your job is done the moment

the meeting is on the calendar.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will be given a clean list of business names and phone numbers, a

proven script, and access to every tool you need. From there:



- Work the list, get past gatekeepers, and reach the owner or decision

  maker

- Book qualified introductory meetings directly into our calendar

- Log every call outcome accurately in the CRM, including who you spoke

  to and what they said

- Send a short confirmation to every booked prospect and follow up to

  reduce no-shows

- Flag bad numbers, wrong contacts, and closed businesses so the list

  improves over time

- Report your numbers at the end of each day (dials, connects, meetings

  booked)





HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED



The daily target is 100 dials, which is 500 per week. But we judge you

on MEETINGS BOOKED, not dials.



To be direct: if you make 70 dials a day and book 15 meetings a week,

that is a better result than 120 dials a day and 5 meetings. We would

rather you slow down, get through to the right person, and have a real

conversation than rush through a list to hit a number.



The dial target is a floor for effort, not the thing you are graded on.



What does not work is low dials AND low meetings. If both are down, the

role is not working.





REQUIREMENTS



- Near-native spoken English with a neutral accent and no hesitation.

  You need to sound like a natural conversation to a US business owner,

  not like someone reading. This is the single most important

  requirement for this role.

- Ability to go off script. Gatekeepers ask unexpected questions and you

  must respond naturally in the moment.

- Proven track record of B2B cold calling into the US market and booking

  meetings. Be ready to discuss what industry you called, your connect

  and booking rates, and what worked.

- Comfortable with gatekeepers. Not aggressive, not apologetic. Calm and

  hard to brush off.

- Reliable fiber internet with a backup connection, a quiet home office,

  and a noise-cancelling headset. No background noise, no call center

  floor, no family in the room.

- Consistent availability during US Eastern business hours.

- Coachable. We record and review calls, give direct feedback, and

  expect you to apply it.





NICE TO HAVE



- Experience calling owner-operated small businesses rather than

  enterprise

- Familiarity with a CRM and a power dialer

- Experience in med spa, aesthetics, healthcare, or professional

  services





HOW TO APPLY



1. Send a short note about your US B2B cold calling background with real

   numbers. Start your message with the word "MIAMI" so we know you read

   this post.



2. Attach TWO voice recordings:

   - Recording 1: You reading a short cold call script, about 60

     seconds. We will send the script if you ask, or use one of your own.

   - Recording 2 (more important): Answer this unscripted in your own

     words, about 2 minutes. "Tell me about the hardest gatekeeper you

     ever got past and exactly what you said." No script. No

     preparation. Just talk.



   Applications without BOTH recordings will not be reviewed.



3. Shortlisted candidates do a live video call with us. Part interview,

   part live role play where we play a difficult gatekeeper.



4. Successful candidates start a PAID two-week trial on real dials

   before anything becomes ongoing.





WHAT YOU GET FROM US



- A clean, pre-built lead list. You never source your own numbers.

- A script that already works, plus objection handling.

- All software and phone systems paid for.

- Direct feedback on recorded calls so you actually improve.

- More hours and higher pay as your booking volume grows.

title: Full-Time Paid Media Buyer for DTC Ecommerce Brand
description:
Full-Time Paid Media Buyer for DTC Ecommerce Brand



Summary



We are a fast-growing DTC ecommerce brand selling consumer products in the US market, and we are looking for an experienced Paid Media Buyer to join our team full-time.



This is not a freelance, part-time, agency, or short-term position.



Meta Ads will be your primary responsibility, but we also want someone who is comfortable expanding and testing across TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, and AppLovin.



You should have hands-on experience managing approximately $1,000 to $5,000+ per day in paid ad spend, preferably for DTC ecommerce brands.



We already have an internal team handling video editing, design, landing pages, and operations. Your role is to manage performance, identify winning angles, develop testing strategies, guide the creative team, and scale what works.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



You will manage our paid advertising campaigns daily, with Meta as the primary channel.



You’ll monitor performance and make decisions around budgets, campaign structures, audiences, bidding, placements, creative allocation, and scaling.



You’ll also help us launch, test, and scale campaigns across TikTok, Pinterest, and AppLovin, identifying which products, creatives, and angles are best suited to each platform.



A major part of this position is creative strategy.



You’ll work closely with our internal team to develop new hooks, angles, UGC concepts, ad copy, static ads, video concepts, and creative briefs based on actual performance data.



We expect continuous testing. You should be able to look at campaign performance and determine what we should test next rather than simply turning campaigns on and off.



You’ll also analyze the customer journey, including advertorials, landing pages, product pages, offers, bundles, upsells, and checkout performance, and recommend improvements that can increase conversion rate and profitability.



Who We’re Looking For



You should have proven experience personally managing approximately $1,000 to $5,000+ per day in paid advertising spend for DTC or ecommerce brands.



Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager is required.



Experience with TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, and AppLovin is highly preferred. You do not need to be equally strong across every platform, but you should understand how creative strategy and campaign structure differ between channels.



You should understand Pixel, CAPI, attribution, campaign structures, creative testing, retargeting, audience testing, and performance analysis.



You should also understand direct-response creative, including hooks, angles, offers, UGC, advertorials, VSLs, landing pages, and conversion funnels.



Most importantly, we want someone who can think independently.



If CPA suddenly increases, CTR falls, CPM rises, or a winning creative begins to fatigue, we expect you to investigate why and propose what we should test next.



What We Offer



This is a full-time, long-term position with a growing ecommerce company investing heavily in paid acquisition.



You’ll work with an established internal team and have access to significant advertising budgets, existing campaign data, creatives, funnels, and products to test.



There is substantial room to grow with the company for someone who consistently produces results.



Compensation is negotiable based on experience and track record.



Important



We are only looking for a full-time individual media buyer.



Please do not apply if you are an agency, looking for freelance projects, managing a large portfolio of outside clients, or only available part-time.



We want someone who can make this position their primary focus.



To Apply



Please include:



1. Examples of DTC/ecommerce campaigns you personally managed, including approximate daily spend.

2. Screenshots or case studies showing spend, revenue, ROAS, CPA, or other relevant performance metrics.

3. Your experience with Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and AppLovin, including approximately how much spend you have personally managed on each.

4. Examples of winning ads, hooks, creative briefs, or testing concepts you developed.

5. Explain how you would approach scaling a Meta campaign from $1,000/day to $5,000+/day while maintaining profitability.

6. Explain how you identify creative fatigue and d
 what concepts or angles to test next.

7. Tell us which paid advertising platform you consider your strongest and why.

8. Confirm that you are available for a full-time, long-term position.



Please start your application with the words “FULL TIME MEDIA BUYER” so we know you read the entire job description.

title: Bilingual Admin VA (English/Spanish) — Vehicle Rental Company
description:
About us



FastLane Hustle Rentals is a vehicle rental company in South Florida. We rent cars on 28-day renewable terms to gig-economy drivers — Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Amazon Flex, Instacart — across three counties. Our customers are working drivers. The car is how they feed their family, so this work is fast, personal, and it matters.



We are a small, tight team. There is no call center behind you. Everything runs through one system (GoHighLevel), and everything gets logged.



The role in one sentence



Every Spanish-speaking lead that comes into FastLane is yours — from the first phone call, through the rental, through every renewal after that.



This is not a script-reading appointment-setter job and it is not a back-office data-entry job. You are the entire customer relationship for a whole segment of our business. If you are good at this, you will have your own book of accounts that you personally built.



Why Spanish is required



A large share of South Florida gig drivers speak Spanish as their first language, and right now those leads do not get the same attention as our English leads. That is the gap you are filling. Our sales script is maintained in Spanish as well as English.



You need to sell, calm someone down, and chase a late payment — all in Spanish, on the phone, with a real person. This is not "some Spanish would be nice." Textbook Spanish will not survive the first call.



Part 1 — You own the lead

Take the inbound call. Leads come in through our system. You call them back fast. Speed is most of the job.

Qualify. Is the driver 25 or older, living in our service area, already approved and active on at least one gig app, and looking for a month or more? If they are not yet approved on a platform, they cannot finish — you tag the lead and set a callback instead of running the pitch.

Discovery. Which apps they run, how long they have been driving, what they are trying to solve.

Present the program. One flat weekly price that includes the car, the coverage, the taxes, unlimited miles, and maintenance. No deposit, no credit check.

Quote the car. Off our live availability sheet, built up in a specific order that we will train you on. There is a right way and a wrong way to say the number, and the wrong way loses the deal.

Send the exact car. Photos of that specific vehicle on our lot, by text. Everything after this happens in that thread.

Collect two things. A photo of their driver's license through our secure link, and proof of their active gig platform. Nothing else on the call.

Hand off for screening, then call the customer back the same day with the approval and a pickup time. That callback is the close. If it slips, the lead is gone.

Get the paperwork signed and the pickup booked.

Part 2 — You keep the customer



Once your customer has the keys, they stay yours:



Renewals. Every rental renews on a 28-day cycle. Seven days out you call and confirm: extending or returning? Log it the same day.

Payments. Verify the weekly payment landed. When one is missed, you contact the customer daily. Unresolved at 72 hours, you escalate to management — you document, you do not decide enforcement.

Weekly tolls. Every Monday, pull the prior week's tolls, match each one to the right customer, and invoice it.

Problems with the car. Gather the details and dispatch to our Fleet Coordinator. You do not diagnose vehicles.

Returns. Coordinate the return and get the car back on the availability board fast. An idle car earns nothing.

Notes. Every call, every commitment, every next step goes into the system. Our rule: if it is not logged, it did not happen.

Hard rules you will be trained on



These are legal and safety boundaries, not preferences. We check them.



No money on the phone. Ever. No deposit, no reservation fee, no card number. The first payment happens at pickup, in person. South Florida drivers are primed against rental scams — asking for money on a call kills the deal and reads as fraud.

You never give coverage advice. We are not an insurance agency and you are never the agent. If someone asks whether a specific situation is covered, the answer is always "let me confirm that and follow up," then you escalate. Saying the wrong thing here is a legal problem, not a sales problem.

You never promise income. Not to a driver, not to a vehicle owner.

You never change the price or the terms. Rates come off the sheet. Exceptions require written approval.

You never skip a screening step. Every step exists because something went wrong once.

When in doubt, escalate. "Let me confirm that for you" is always an acceptable answer here.

Requirements

Fluent, natural Spanish and English, spoken and written. You will be selling and collecting in both, by phone, every day.

Real phone confidence. You will make outbound calls to strangers, present a price, and ask for a commitment. You will also call people about money they owe. If that drains you, this is not your role.

Available Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM US Eastern Time. Non-negotiable — it is when our customers and our office are awake. Check what that is in your local time before applying.

Reliable phone and internet. Minimum 10 Mbps down / 5 Mbps up, a backup connection, a quiet room, and a quality headset. Background noise on a sales call costs us deals.

Organized under load. You will carry dozens of open files at once, each on its own clock, with callbacks that cannot slip.

Follows a process exactly. We need someone who works the system, not someone who improvises.

Long-term. This is a permanent seat, not a short project.

Nice to have (not required)

Phone sales, inside sales, retention, collections, or account management experience

Experience with GoHighLevel, or any CRM (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce)

Experience with a US-based company — especially automotive, rental, logistics, or fleet

Google Sheets



What we offer:

$7.00 USD/hour, paid twice monthly on the 1st and 15th

Full-time, stable, long-term work with a company that is growing its fleet

Paid training, a written script, and SOPs for every step

Direct access to the owner — no layers, no bureaucracy

Real ownership of a segment of the business, with room to grow into a senior seat as we scale



Do not apply if:

Your spoken Spanish or English is not genuinely conversational

You are uncomfortable selling or asking for a commitment on the phone

You cannot commit to US Eastern business hours

You are looking for part-time or short-term work, or juggling several other clients



FIELD: HOW TO APPLY / APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



I read every application that follows these steps. I delete every one that does not.



1. Put this exact phrase in your subject line: FASTLANE-ES



2. Answer these three questions in your message:



What time is 9:00 AM US Eastern in your local time, and can you work through 6:00 PM Eastern every weekday?

Tell me about a time you sold something over the phone, or convinced a hesitant customer to commit. What did you say?

Where did you learn Spanish, and how often do you currently speak it?



3. Record a voice sample and share the link (Google Drive, Dropbox, or Vocaroo). About two minutes total, unscripted:



First 30 seconds, in English: introduce yourself and describe your work setup and internet connection.

Next 45 seconds, in Spanish: you are calling a driver named Carlos who asked about renting a car for Uber. Introduce yourself and the company, find out which apps he drives for and how long he has been driving, and ask for the appointment.

Last 45 seconds, in Spanish: same Carlos, three weeks later. His weekly payment was due two days ago and has not come through. Be polite, be clear, and get a commitment on when he will pay.



The Spanish recordings are the most important part of this application. Please do not use AI voice generation, a word-for-word script read, or a translation tool. I will be able to tell, and it is an automatic no.



4. Attach a screenshot of your internet speed test (speedtest.net).



Shortlisted applicants get a short video interview with me directly.

title: Content Strategist & Copywriter
description:
Part-Time Initially, Path to Full-Time Within Two Weeks 



Summary:

We're hiring a genuinely creative content strategist and copywriter to own the ideas and the execution behind our clients' social media. This is a part-time role starting immediately, moving to full-time as our client base grows.



The Situation:

We're a fast-growing agency working with service-based businesses across a range of industries. Our content manager has been handling content creation herself, but as we scale she needs to focus on managing.

Meanwhile, clients have told us the content feels too AI-generated and too generic. We'll keep using AI for speed, but the ideas, the angles, and the voice need to come from a real person. That's the role.



What You'll Be Doing:

- Building content calendars for multiple clients

- Writing an individual content brief for every post so our designers know exactly what to make

- Writing captions that sound like a human wrote them

- Pitching original content concepts: educational, entertainment, and CTA posts that have a real shot at performing, not just filling a slot

- Clipping long-form content in Opus for short-form use

- Maintaining and improving our anti-AI system so nothing we publish reads like a machine wrote it

- Staying current in ClickUp and Slack daily, and reviewing your tasks and client calendars at end of day

- Reporting to our content manager



What We're Looking For:

- Native or near-native English, plus a real feel for American culture, humor, and trends

- Proven social copywriting experience and a portfolio that doesn't read as AI-generated

- Someone who can take a "boring" service business and make it interesting

- An ideas person. We don't want the same five post formats recycled forever. We want someone who pushes on what's - possible and brings concepts we wouldn't have thought of

- An understanding of the difference between vanity metrics and actual results (leads, booked meetings)

- Comfort using AI in your workflow while keeping the output human

- Ability to work independently, take feedback, and communicate well with the team



The Opportunity:

We're growing fast. This starts part-time with hours based on current workload, and becomes full-time as we bring on more clients. There's real room to grow here for the right person.



To Apply, please send us three things:

1. Your portfolio, or 3 to 5 examples of social content you personally wrote (note which parts were yours)

2. One content idea you'd pitch for a service business in a "boring" industry. Two or three sentences is plenty, no design needed. We mostly want to see how you think

3. Your hourly rate, weekly availability, and whether you're interested in full-time down the road



We're hiring immediately and want to start ASAP.

We are looking for someone to take ownership of our content, video and social presence, and to support the marketing systems sitting behind it.



It starts at two days a week. For the right person the opportunity is considerably bigger than that — our intention is to grow the role alongside the person: more days, more scope, and in time the paid advertising we currently send outside. That progression is d
 by what you produce, not by how long you have been here.



What the role actually is

The larger part is content — video editing, graphic design and social media management. Turning raw footage shot on a phone on a building site, with no script and no shot list, into short-form video people stop scrolling for. Building the graphics and client-facing material around it, and running the calendar across Instagram,
 and 
. There is also the chance to work with professionally shot photography and video, and to put your own flair and style through our socials and website.



The rest is the machinery behind it — our CRM, our website, our search presence, and the numbers that tell us whether any of it is working. We want both halves in one person. It is a genuinely hard combination to find, which is why we are being specific rather than hoping.



The content side

- Turning raw site footage into finished Reels — walkthroughs, before-and-afters, progress, behind the scenes, the trades at work

- Cutting talking-head video with our director into something watchable

- Editing and colour-correcting project photography

- Carousels, branded graphics, marketing one-pagers, and the client-facing PDFs and information packs we send through pre-construction

- Repurposing long-form material — blogs, videos, site notes — into social-ready pieces

- Running and improving our content calendar across Instagram,
 and 

- Working with our site team to pull out the moments worth filming, and telling them what you need from them

- Watching what performs and telling us what you would change

- Bringing us ideas we did not ask for



The systems side

- Working in our CRM — pipelines, opportunities, forms, custom fields

- Supporting workflows and automations,
 and SMS campaigns

- Making sure enquiries are captured properly and followed through

- Blog uploads and page updates on our website, with half an eye on how they are structured for search

- Tracking what actually produces enquiries, not just impressions



We use GoHighLevel. Hands-on GHL experience is a real advantage and we want to hear about it in detail. Comparable CRM experience — HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Keap, Zoho — plus a genuine ability to learn systems works too. Over time we want to bring more of our paid advertising in-house, so if you understand how ads, search and analytics fit together, that is where this role has the most room to grow



How we think about AI

We use AI here every day and we expect you to. Being good with it is a skill we value.



What we are hiring is your judgement — the pacing of a cut, the hook in the first two seconds, the reason one shot follows another, the voice in a caption. Our homes are custom and our content should feel the same way: recognisably ours.



If you can point at a real piece of your own work and tell us exactly where the model helped and where you took over, you are the sort of person we want to talk to.



Who this suits

You will not be expected to work it all out alone. You will have plenty of support while you learn our business, our brand and the way we work, and we expect questions during onboarding — we collaborate closely as a team.



As you settle in we will expect you to take increasing ownership of your work. The people who do well with us bring solutions rather than questions, flag issues early rather than on the deadline, take feedback well and go around again to hit the standard, and genuinely care about what they put their name to. Every so often they send us something nobody asked for that turns out to be exactly what we needed.



If you want to be told exactly what to do each morning, this will frustrate you. If you have been looking for somewhere that gives you real ownership and rewards it, this is that.



What you need

- Around three years of hands-on content creation experience — where video, design and social content have been a meaningful part of your actual role. If you have less but a portfolio that speaks for itself, apply anyway

- Strong short-form vertical video editing — building an edit from raw, unsorted footage rather than working from a template

- Confidence in CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or DaVinci Resolve — whichever is genuinely yours, and tell us which

- Strong Canva skills and the discipline to hold an existing brand kit

- Real hands-on confidence inside a CRM, ideally GoHighLevel

- Fluency with AI tools, and the judgement to keep the creative decisions your own

- Excellent written and spoken English

- The ability to work two days a week without being chased, and to say early when

something will not be ready



Helpful, not essential: construction, architecture or property experience · Google Ads or Meta Ads · SEO fundamentals and Google Analytics · WordPress · Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or InDesign · LinkedIn content



How to apply

One honest note first. We know some people will paste this ad into an AI tool and send back whatever comes out. We are not against you using AI to help you write — we use it every day ourselves. But we can tell the difference between an application written with help and one where nobody was really there, and we only want to hear from people who actually want this particular job at this particular company.



Two of the things below cannot be produced by a tool. They are the two we read first.

1. Your resume

2. A link to your portfolio. We want to see short-form video you have edited yourself, not only static work

3. One or two sentences on our Instagram — 
 — go and look at it, then tell us one thing you would change and one thing you would keep. Be honest; we would genuinely rather hear a real criticism than a compliment

4. A few lines in your own words on why this role suits you. This one is for someone who wants to grow inside a tight-knit team and wants their work rewarded



Put the word PROCESS at the top so we know you read to the bottom.

title: Web Automation Engineer
description:
Location: Remote

Type: Contract

Experience: 4+ years



About Mogul:

Mogul is building the financial infrastructure for independent musicians. We help artists audit their catalogs, track royalties across fragmented systems, and fix broken or missing registrations so they can collect the money they’re owed all from one place.



The music industry has long struggled with messy metadata, disconnected platforms, and opaque reporting. Mogul is taking a bottoms-up approach to solving that problem by supporting thousands of royalty data types and presenting them in a single, intuitive product experience. Our goal is simple: give artists clarity and control over their income.

The Role



We are looking for a contract full-stack software engineer to help us upgrade our royalty web-scraping platform to the next level, while maintaining the current infrastructure. You’ll work with Mogul’s engineering team, using automation tools like Playwright to make our applications more robust and resilient, to help prepare for sustained and rapid growth.

Candidates should be able to demonstrate previous experience with browser automation libraries like Playwright or Puppeteer. We are a small, high-velocity team and you will need to hit the ground running. Understanding the fundamentals of web application development, including authentication strategies, and how to efficiently automate requests against the most popular frontend paradigms (SPA, SSR, etc) is a must.



What You’ll Do

Maintain existing scraping infrastructure, implementing timely bug fixes

Improve efficiency of existing automation code

Build new automation scripts to expand our coverage of supported royalty portals

Work with engineering and product teams to iterate fast and ship often



Your Experience

4+ years of professional full-stack software engineering experience

Strong proficiency with TypeScript and NextJS; proficiency with Python, C# or Java

Familiarity with browser automation libraries like Playwright or Puppeteer

Experience building and working with GraphQL or REST APIs

Detailed knowledge of the inner workings of modern web applications, and the ability to reverse engineer how they work

Comfortable working in an early-stage, fast-moving environment

Bonus: expertise with mitigating browser automation detection and bypassing captchas



About You

You’re an experienced software engineer that takes ownership of what they build

You love taking things apart to see how they work

You communicate clearly and don’t need heavy process to do great work

You’re excited about empowering artists and making their data accessible to them



Why Mogul

Real ownership and impact on a product used by working artists

Direct access to leadership and product decision-making

Flexible, remote contract

title: Transaction Coordinator - Residential Real Estate
description:
Dannecker & Associates Closing Assistant



The Closing Assistant role at Dannecker & Associates involves overseeing all administrative and compliance details of real estate transactions, working to ensure a smooth closing process for our team and their clients. This position requires acute attention to detail, organizational and administrative skills, as well as the ability to be resourceful and solution-driven. Our mission is to improve the lives of others by ensuring the very best experience when buying, selling homes and investments. We strive to achieve this experience by incorporating Dannecker & Associates’ Core Values into each interaction: Do the Right Thing, Thirst for Learning, Quality and Focus, Spirit of Winning, Collaborate without Ego, Fun & Laughter, Resourcefulness.



Core Responsibilities:



Transaction Management: Oversee the entire contract to close process, ensuring all deadlines, contingencies and CAR/Compass requirements are met.

Document Handling: Handle the preparation, review, execution and tracking of a large volume of real estate documents (contracts, disclosures, addenda, reports, escrow documents, etc.), ensuring accuracy and brokerage compliance.

Brokerage Compliance: Navigate Compass Business Tracker platform to validate the accuracy of all transaction documents, working with the Compass Compliance team to ensure each file adheres to all local, state, and company regulations, overseeing the lifecycle of the Business Tracker file from open to close.

File Maintenance: Maintain meticulously organized files, keeping the Google Drive and Business Tracker up-to-date. Perform file audits. Follow all closing procedures upon the conclusion of each escrow to ensure proper database management.

Special Projects: Embody a growth mindset to expand your skillset and navigate new projects as team needs expand. Crosstrain with various departments as needed.

Continuing Education: Stay informed and educated on all form updates and evolving brokerage requirements.

Oversee the Full Transaction Lifecycle: Utilize Glide for the preparation/completion of seller disclosures upon the receipt of an executed Listing Agreement. Manage all administrative and procedural steps from the ---------- nt a contract is executed until the final closing date.

Deadline Tracking: Meticulously track and manage all contractual deadlines and contingencies.

Problem-Solving: Proactively monitor transaction progress, identify potential issues or delays, and work with relevant parties to resolve them efficiently before they impact closing.

Zillow: Actively manage the Zillow system; Prepare Invoices, and close out all Zillow Preferred transactions by each deadline.

Communication: Serve as the central point of contact, providing timely communication for agents, clients, lenders, title/escrow companies and teammates. Much of the communication is via
 so proper English writing skills are a must.

Real Estate Agents (our team): Provide file audits, answer process/compliance questions, and ensure all necessary documentation is completed and conveyed in a timely manner.

Clients (Buyers/Sellers): Collaborate with Buyer/Sellers to ensure all broker documentation is received, reviewed, and fully executed in a timely manner. Assist with any non-sales-related communication, redirecting/providing a warm handoff to any party within the transaction, as deemed applicable. Provide deposit and contingency removal updates. Order Home Warranties (buyer-side escrows) and provide Utility reminders.

Cooperating Agent/Transaction Coordinator: Create a collaborative environment to ensure the needs of each broker file are met, and communication is properly documented. Request contingency removals for seller-side transactions.

Title/Escrow: Deliver necessary documents, coordinate signed commission instructions and escrow amendments, and verify settlement statements.

Lenders: Monitor loan progress, provide required documentation, and track loan commitment milestones.

Finance: Provide the finance manager with prompt updates on accelerated close of escrow dates, agent credits, purchase price changes, sales manager approvals, Modifications (MT-BR or MT-LA) and updated Zillow invoices as applicable.

Follow Up Boss: Update stage, make sure transaction is input as sold, update new address, remove old address, update close date. Update notes on client.

title: SR TALENT ACQUISITION COORDINATOR, CONTRACT
description:
senior Search Associate

Contract · Remote (Philippines-based) · MissFit Coaching in Chicago USA 



Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time hours

Reports to: David Sho, Head Customer Success

Location: Remote, based in the Philippines



ABOUT MISSFIT

MissFit Coaching is a boutique reverse-recruiting and executive career strategy firm. We work with mid-career and senior white-collar professionals — many in active job transitions — to run their job search the way a search firm runs a client mandate: proactive targeting, hidden-market outreach, and disciplined pipeline management, not just resume tweaks and job board applications. Our founder is an ICF-pcc certified coach with 30 years of corporate HR and executive search experience.



THE ROLE

We're hiring a senior Search Associate to support reverse-recruiting operations for our clients — director, VP, and C-suite candidates navigating their own search. This is an execution and support role: you'll follow MissFit's documented playbooks to build target lists, maintain trackers, and support candidate positioning, working closely with and under the direction of our Customer Success team.



You'll work inside our proprietary Momentum Maximizer tracking system, our Fit Finder scoring standard, and our daily team rhythm (Slack standups, commit cards, go-live QA gates) — with clear process, complete training, and a lead reviewing your work as you grow into the role.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

— Build target company and contact lists for clients who are seeking new jobs at the director-to-C-suite level, using tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Apollo, following provided targeting criteria

— Support hiring-signal research (leadership changes, funding events, org shifts) under a lead's direction

— Draft outreach messaging and positioning that our senior clients will send under their name

— Maintain client search trackers (our proprietary Momentum Maximizer system) with complete, accurate, and current data

— Score job opportunities against client fit criteria using our Fit Finder standard

— Flag stalled searches, missed follow-ups, and networking gaps to your lead

— Communicate search updates clearly, in writing, to the internal team







WHAT YOU BRING

— 4+ years of experience in HR, talent acquisition, or recruiting — corporate or agency setting, MINIMUM

-    Quick learner, experienced with AI, Claude, and Perplexity

— Highly organized, with strong attention to detail and follow-through on multi-step processes

— A strong work ethic — dependable, timely, and able to keep pace with a full caseload

— Clear, professional written English — you'll draft messaging that is highly polished and grammatically perfect grammar

— Comfort learning sourcing and tracking tools (LinkedIn, Apollo, Momentum Maximizer) — training provided

— Comfort with confidential, high-stakes work — you're often handling someone's livelihood and reputation

— Based in the Philippines, able to work hours with meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time

— Comfort operating inside a defined system (trackers, scoring standards, daily standups) with regular feedback and oversight



HOW YOU'RE MEASURED

Once onboarded, your performance is tracked on accuracy and consistency — tracker quality, on-time follow-through, and adherence to process — alongside the client satisfaction and renewal outcomes the broader team is judged on. Strong performers have a clear path to the Executive Search Operator role.



HOW WE EVALUATE CANDIDATES

Our hiring process is deliberately rigorous because the work is high-trust. Expect:

— Three short written screening answers (under 200 words each, no AI tools), If you write to us with AI, you will be disqualified.  I don't want to read an AI-written letter.  I want a letter written by a human. I like humans.

— A one-minute unscripted video introduction.  We want you to just talk to us. No script.

— A short interview

— A paid 30 trial engagement before any ongoing contract is confirmed



WHY THIS ROLE

This is a chance to build real HR and recruiting experience into an executive search discipline — inside a fully remote contract role with a U.S.-based firm, working alongside a 30-year executive search and HR veteran. Strong performers have a defined growth path to Executive Search Operator over time.   



You will work with other people from the Philippines, Nigeria, Pakistan, and the USA. We are a global, nimble, fast-paced, remote-first team.  



Fixed salary plus opportunity for commission.  Salary depends on your skills. 



TO APPLY

 your resume and a brief intro video (unscripted, one minute) to 
 with the subject line: "Search Associate."

title: Accounts Receivable & Executive Assistant
description:
Company: Melitta Baumeister

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Schedule: Minimum 5-hour overlap with Eastern Time (New York)



About Melitta Baumeister



Melitta Baumeister is an independent New York fashion label known for a sculptural design language built on humor, inclusivity, and a rejection of elitism. The brand is a CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund winner and a Cooper Hewitt National Design Award recipient and works with a global network of wholesale accounts alongside a direct-to-consumer business.



We are a small team, which means this role carries real ownership from day one and direct access to the people making decisions.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Financial Controller (Remote, Philippines) | US Interior Design Firm

Full-time (40 hrs/week) · Independent contractor · US$3,166/month, paid semi-monthly in USD

We are bringing our accounting fully in-house by the end of 2026, and we are hiring the Controller who will own that build. This is not a maintain-the-books role. You will inherit a ledger that needs real remediation, an outsourced accounting firm to replace, and a mandate to build the accounting function from the ground up, reporting directly to the executive leading the transition.



About the Role

Twelve months from now, you will have rebuilt trust in our numbers and made the outsourced firm unnecessary. Accounting runs in-house on QuickBooks Online under controls you designed, the month-end close is yours and it is reliable, leadership works from a reporting package you produce, and the historical cleanup of unreconciled receivables, deposit balances, and revenue recognition is behind us. You will have hired or contracted the transaction-processing support you need and you will manage it.

What You'll Own

• The general ledger in QuickBooks Online and the full month-end close.

• Remediation of historical data: AR and customer-deposit reconciliation, payment matching against bank records, and revenue recognition cleanup.

• The plan and execution for transitioning bookkeeping and accounting from our outsourced firm to your in-house function by end of year.

• The monthly reporting package: P&L and balance sheet on both accrual and cash basis with a reconciling bridge, AR aging, 13-week cash forecast, and margin by revenue line.

• The structure of the accounting department: you recommend build vs. contract for transaction legwork, then manage whichever path we choose.

• Controls and process: documented procedures, work done in our systems only, no third-party-held credentials.

What We're Looking For

Required:

• CPA (Philippine CPA welcome) with 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, including controller or accounting-manager scope.

• Deep, hands-on QuickBooks Online experience.

• US GAAP knowledge and prior work for US companies; fluent in both accrual and cash-basis reporting.

• A messy-ledger cleanup you personally led (unreconciled AR, unmatched payments, or revenue recognition fixes) that you can walk us through in detail.

• Excellent written English and at least 4 hours of daily overlap with US business hours (Mountain/Eastern time).

Preferred:

• Project-based accounting: customer deposits, procurement markups, FF&E/inventory, WIP (interior design, construction, or architecture industries).

• Experience taking accounting in-house from an outsourced provider.

• Exposure to US multi-state sales/use tax.

• Experience hiring and managing accounting staff or subcontracted bookkeepers.

Compensation & Terms

• full-time, engaged as an independent contractor.

• Paid semi-monthly in USD via international transfer.

• Long-term role with a direct reporting line to the Chief Administrative Officer.

• Fully remote; you provide a reliable home-office setup and stable internet.

How to Apply

Send your resume with the subject line "CONTROLLER - [Your Name]" and include a short paragraph (5–8 sentences) describing a ledger remediation you personally led: what was broken, what you did, and the measurable outcome. Applications without this paragraph will not be reviewed.

3+ years editing professionally, with a reel showing long-form storytelling — not just a sizzle of your best 15-second moments

Story instincts. You can find the through-line in an hour of raw interview without a paper edit handed to you.

Multi-cam syncing and cutting, including matching cameras that don't match

Comfort working from a brand kit and taking direction without relitigating notes

Honest timelines and early communication when something slips

## ⚠️ PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING



I am looking for an **experienced U.S. real estate cold caller** to join my growing real estate investment business.



This is NOT a general virtual assistant position.



This is NOT a beginner telemarketing position.



This is NOT a data-entry job.
