description:
JOB OVERVIEW

We are a fast-growing US-based company active in US Government Contracting (GovCon) and Public Sector Procurement. We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and highly skilled Proposal Writer & Bid Compliance Expert to lead our end-to-end RFP/RFQ proposal responses.

In US Federal & Public Sector Procurement, submission accuracy and strict compliance are non-negotiable—a single missing clause or formatting error means immediate disqualification. We need a seasoned proposal writer who understands how to dissect SOWs, build comprehensive compliance matrices, and craft compelling, high-scoring technical responses.

If you have a proven track record of writing winning bids for US federal, state, or local agencies, we want to hear from you!

???? KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

End-to-End Proposal Creation: Draft, structure, and finalize compliant responses for RFPs, RFQs, IFBs, and ITBs.

Compliance Matrix & SOW Analysis: Thoroughly review solicitation documents and Statement of Work (SOW) requirements to build accurate compliance matrices.

Technical Writing: Write high-scoring narrative sections, including Technical Execution Plans, Quality Control Protocols, Management Plans, Past Performance summaries, and Capability Statements.

FAR/DFARS Alignment: Ensure all bid responses comply strictly with federal acquisition regulations and client guidelines.

Review & Final Polish: Collaborate with leadership to review draft proposals, eliminate errors, ensure 100% compliance, and submit well ahead of deadlines.

???? WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR (REQUIREMENTS)

Proven US GovCon Experience: At least 2+ years of direct experience writing and managing US government proposals (Federal, State, or Local).

Deep Portal & Process Knowledge: Familiarity with SAM.gov, NAICS/PSC codes, FAR/DFARS regulations, and standard RFP/RFQ structures.

Exceptional Written English: Advanced/Native-level written English (C1/C2) with strong persuasive and technical writing skills.

No Unedited AI: Ability to write clear, humanized, agency-specific content (we strictly test for and reject unedited ChatGPT output).

Extreme Attention to Detail: Zero tolerance for compliance errors, missing attachments, or missed deadlines.

❌ THIS POSITION IS NOT FOR YOU IF:

You are a beginner looking for on-the-job training in GovCon writing.

You rely on unedited ChatGPT or generic template dumps.

You manage multiple full-time client commitments and cannot deliver focused, reliable work.

You require step-by-step micromanagement to meet strict submission deadlines.

???? WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Pay: $600 – $900+/month based on verified experience and past bid win volume.

Long-Term Stability: Stable, long-term positioning with performance-based raises as bid wins increase.

Growth Opportunity: Potential to lead our proposal team as our GovCon footprint expands.

Supportive Environment: Clear directives, direct access to leadership, and streamline processes.

???? MANDATORY APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

To prove your attention to detail and relevant experience, you MUST answer the following 4 screening questions in your initial application message:

TRACK RECORD: What is the total dollar value or win volume of US Government contracts you have directly written winning proposals for? Please share specific agency types or project scopes if possible.

COMPLIANCE MATRIX SCENARIO: Describe your step-by-step process for reviewing a 50+ page RFP SOW and turning it into a complete, bulletproof Compliance Matrix.

TECH STACK & TOOLS: List all procurement portals, bid tools, and documentation software you are fluent with (e.g., SAM.gov, GovWin, MS Word/Excel, Adobe Acrobat, Google Workspace).

SALARY & AVAILABILITY: What is your target monthly salary (in USD) and weekly hours availability (Full-Time or Part-Time)?

⚠️ ATTENTION TO DETAIL TEST:

Format your application message subject line EXACTLY as follows:

GOVCON PROPOSAL WRITER - [Your Full Name]

(Example: GOVCON PROPOSAL WRITER - Juan Dela Cruz)

Applications missing answers to the screening questions or using automated boilerplate messages will be automatically rejected.

title: Appointment Setter - Men's Fitness & Lifestyle Coaching
description:
We're Scaling — And We Need a Proven Closer of Conversations, Not a Trainee



Look Good Naked Co. (LGNC) helps busy professional men get in the best shape of their lives — no bro-science, no fluff, just results. We run our sales process almost entirely through Instagram DMs, and we're about to scale hard.



That means we need someone who's already done this job well, somewhere else, and is ready to do it here for the long haul.



This is not an entry-level role. If you don't have real, provable setter experience, please don't apply — you'll save us both the time.



What You'll Be Doing

???? Running warm, inbound Instagram DM conversations with men who've already shown interest in coaching

???? Qualifying leads — understanding their goals, situation, urgency, and fit — before handing off to close

???? Following a structured framework (not a script) to move conversations forward naturally, without sounding like a "sales bot"

???? Matching our brand voice: direct, calm authority, no hype, no generic sales-coach energy

???? Hitting KPIs around response time, conversation quality, and booked calls

???? Working closely with our team (Coach Mick, Coach Lachy and the LGNC leadership) as part of an ongoing, structured onboarding and training system — not a "figure it out yourself" setup



Who We're Looking For

✅ Minimum 1–2 years of real experience as an Instagram/DM appointment setter or closer — ideally in fitness, coaching, or a similar high-ticket service niche

✅ Experience setting for Australian coaches or Australian audiences is a strong preference — you understand the tone, the directness, the vernacular, and you're not going to sound like a generic American sales script

✅ Someone looking for a long-term role, not a stepping stone — we're building a real team and we want to invest in people who are going to grow with us

✅ Strong written English, sharp instincts for tone and timing in conversation, and the discipline to follow a system while still sounding human

✅ Reliable, coachable, and takes ownership of their numbers

❌ No experience = please don't apply. We're not running a training program for first-timers right now — we need someone who can hit the ground running as we scale.



Why LGNC

???? We're growing fast, and this role will grow with the business — more volume, more responsibility, more opportunity over time for the right person

???? Real onboarding, real systems — you'll be supported by a structured setter wiki, training materials, KPIs, and a brand voice guide, not left to guess

???? We value longevity. We're not looking to churn through setters. If you're good and you stick around, there's a real future here

???? Clear expectations, fair treatment — we run a tight, professional operation and expect the same in return



How to Apply

Serious setters only. Click Apply and include the following in your application:



⚠️ Your DM setting/closing experience (brands, niches, and results if you can share them)

⚠️ Whether you've worked with Australian coaches, brands, or audiences before

⚠️ Why you're looking for a long-term role, not just your next gig

⚠️ Anything you've screen-recorded or can share that shows your conversation style (Loom, screenshots, etc.)

⚠️ Your monthly rate expectation (a range is fine)



Applications that skip these or send a generic template will not be considered.

title: Part-Time Video Editor + Graphics (DaVinci Resolve) - US Tech YouTube Channel
description:
TORR3NT's Tech is a US tech review channel covering streaming devices and consumer tech - 50K+ subscribers on YouTube, 40K+ on TikTok.



YouTube: 

TikTok: 

Instagram: 



I record all the footage and write all the scripts. I need one reliable person to edit the videos and make the graphics.



START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORD "TORRENT" so I know you read this.



=== THE WORK ===



LONG-FORM REVIEWS - 2 per week, 10-20 min each

- Cut from my raw footage and script

- Captions, on-screen text, b-roll placement, sound and music

- Turnaround: 48 hours from when I upload the footage



TECH & GAMING NEWS SHORTS - 5 per week, ~90 sec each

- These are NOT cut from the long-form videos. They are separate pieces, shot fresh.

- I film myself delivering the segment and send you the script

- You cut it, layer in b-roll and simple graphics, add captions

- Turnaround: same day, within 12 hours of me sending the footage. News goes stale fast, and this is the part of the job I'm strictest about.



THUMBNAILS & GRAPHICS

- Custom thumbnails for the long-form videos

- Channel graphics: lower thirds, title cards, end screens

- Photoshop, Affinity, Canva or similar is fine - tell me what you use

- Send the source file with every thumbnail

- looking for non-Ai generate graphics - preferred 



Deliver the DaVinci Resolve project file with every video, long-form and Short.



About 25 hours per week.



=== SCHEDULE ===



Because of the same-day turnaround on news, this is not a "work whenever" job. The timezone works in your favor: I'm in US Eastern, so footage I send in my evening lands in your morning. You edit during normal Philippine daytime hours and I have it before I wake up. But I need you online and responsive on a predictable daily schedule, Monday to Friday.



=== REQUIREMENTS ===



- DaVinci Resolve (the free version is fine) - REQUIRED

- Comfortable with proxy workflows - you edit proxies, I render the 4K master

- Thumbnail and graphic design - this is part of the job, not a bonus

- Able to build simple motion graphics and lower thirds

- Strong written English. Scripts include product names and chip model numbers that must appear on screen spelled exactly right (example: "Snapdragon 8 Gen 3", not "Snapdragon 8Gen3")

- PC: 16GB RAM minimum. Tell me your CPU, GPU and RAM

- Stable internet. Upload speed matters most, since you're the one exporting



=== HOW WE'D WORK ===



- Two rounds of revisions included per video

- Files move over Google Drive

- Long-form music and b-roll come from my licensed library. For news Shorts I'll tell you which clips to use and where to get them.

- Before starting you'll sign a simple independent contractor agreement. In plain English: I own the finished work and the project files, and you keep everything confidential until I publish it.

- Once a video is live, you're welcome to show it in your portfolio.



=== PAY ===



- $5-6 per hour depending on experience, about 25 hours per week

- Paid weekly via PayPal or Wise

- Paid test edit before hiring: $25 for one news Short, so you're not working for free

- Long-term role with room to grow as the channel grows



=== TO APPLY, INCLUDE ===



1. The word TORRENT at the top

2. Links to 2-3 videos you edited - long-form and Shorts if you have both

3. A screenshot of one of those edits open in your Resolve timeline

4. 3-5 thumbnails you designed, and what tool you made them in

5. Your PC specs (CPU/GPU/RAM) and a speedtest.net link

6. Your experience with DaVinci Resolve

7. The daily hours you can commit, in Philippine time

8. Watch one of my recent videos and tell me one specific thing you'd change



Applications without the word TORRENT, portfolio links, or the timeline screenshot will not be reviewed.

title: Director of Recruiting — US Direct-Hire Staffing — Night Shift, Remote
description:
US-based direct-hire staffing firm (healthcare/allied-health core, expanding into new verticals) is hiring a Director of Recruiting to own our ENTIRE delivery organization. Fully remote, Philippines-based, reporting directly to the founder — every recruiting lane, every recruiter, and the company-wide fill number are yours.



This is a staffing-agency delivery leadership seat, not a corporate HR/TA role. You inherit a live board of open US jobs and a small existing delivery team (including a recruiting manager), and you are accountable for one thing: jobs filled. You set the per-req fill strategy across the whole board, install the standards and cadence, coach and grow the team — and because we're a lean firm, you still personally recruit on the hardest, highest-value searches.



Responsibilities

- Own the company-wide open-req board: triage every US job, set a written fill strategy per req, kill or escalate stalled searches honestly.

- Lead the whole delivery org — the recruiting manager and delivery recruiters report to you; run the daily cadence, set quality-gated submittal standards per recruiter, and manage performance to them.

- Personally recruit full-cycle on priority searches: source, screen (live phone/video), prep, and submit.

- Build the machine: playbooks, screening gates, KPIs, capacity plan; recruit and onboard recruiters as volume grows.

- Report the truth to the founder weekly with numbers: pipeline, submittals, interviews, offers, fills — measured, never estimated.



Required

- 6+ years US staffing/recruiting delivery experience, with 3+ years leading delivery teams measured on submittals and placements — agency/staffing-firm side (BPO/RPO delivery centers serving US staffing firms count; in-house corporate TA does not). Leading team leads or managers is a strong plus.

- US healthcare staffing strongly preferred; allied health/imaging a major plus.

- Placements you personally closed — you can name specific placements (role, US state, salary) and walk through exactly how you filled them. There WILL be a detailed walkthrough on the interview.

- Tenure that holds: at least one 24+ month run at a single staffing employer.

- Excellent spoken English — you screen US healthcare professionals and coach everyone who does; live spoken check included.

- Fluent with ATS platforms, modern sourcing, and delivery metrics; can build a KPI dashboard, not just read one.

- Can work the fixed US night shift long-term with a reliable home setup (quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data).



**Do NOT apply if:** your leadership is in-house corporate TA/HR (not agency delivery); you've led sourcing/CV-mining teams only and never owned submittals-to-fill; you cannot name specific placements you personally closed; you're a pure people-manager who no longer recruits; your spoken English isn't strong enough to screen US clinicians; or you can't commit to the fixed US night shift.



Why us: the whole delivery organization is yours — direct line to the founder, real authority over strategy, standards, and team build-out, competitive director-level base plus a placement-linked bonus tied to the fills your org produces, fully remote, long-term.



## APPLICATION QUESTIONS

1. The largest delivery organization you've led: company, your title, total headcount (and layers — did team leads/managers report to you?), what the org was measured on, and its typical monthly submittals + placements.

2. Name ONE placement you PERSONALLY closed in the last 2 years — job title, US state, salary, and how you found the candidate. *(Most important question — real specifics; we verify on the call.)*

3. Your longest single tenure at one staffing employer: company + number of months.

4. You inherit this board: ~20 open US direct-hire jobs (mostly healthcare/allied), a recruiting manager, and 2 recruiters; fill rate has been ~20%. In 5–8 sentences: your first 30 days, step by step, and the number you'd promise the founder for day 90.

5. Can you commit to a FIXED US night shift (~9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT), Mon–Fri, long-term? (Yes/No + any constraint) And your home setup: internet speed, headset, quiet room, backup power/internet?

6. Current/most-recent monthly pay (PHP or USD), earliest start date, and a **30–60 sec voice intro** (link) introducing yourself as if opening a screening call with a US radiologic technologist.

- Review submitted content and provide feedback or direction where needed.

- Follow up to ensure content is produced and published as agreed.

- Identify suitable brands for online collaborations, partnerships and giveaways.

- Coordinate collaboration timelines and ensure both brands complete the agreed activity.



AI and Improved Ways of Working

- Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Canva AI and other suitable platforms to improve quality and efficiency.

- Use AI to assist with content planning, captions, campaign concepts, research and repurposing.

- Review and improve AI-generated work rather than publishing generic or unedited content.

- Stay curious about emerging tools and suggest better ways of completing marketing tasks.



Essential Requirements

- Strong professional graphic-design skills and an excellent visual portfolio.

- Advanced Canva skills together with strong Adobe Photoshop and/or Illustrator skills, or equivalent professional design software.

- Strong image-editing and product-compositing skills, including an understanding of realistic lighting, shadows, scale, perspective and retouching.

- An excellent eye for premium branding, typography, composition, spacing, visual hierarchy and detail.

- Ability to create designs that are not only visually strong but also mobile-friendly and commercially effective.

- Experience creating brochures, presentations, advertisements or other professional marketing assets.

- Social-media planning, creation and publishing experience.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong organisational and project-management skills.

- Ability to manage several campaigns and deadlines at the same time.

- Experience using ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI tools.

- Proactive and confident in contributing ideas.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote team.

- Reliable, responsive and able to take ownership of tasks.



Desirable Experience

- Meta advertising graphics.

- Pinterest strategy and content creation.

- Influencer or creator campaign management.

- Brand collaborations and online giveaways.

- Shopify.

- Amazon listing images or A+ Content.

- CapCut or other short-form video-editing tools.

- Beauty, skincare, wellness, fashion or premium lifestyle brands.

- Product-launch and e-commerce marketing.



The Type of Person We Are Looking For



You may be a strong graphic designer who has moved into marketing, or a creative marketer with particularly strong design skills.



You should enjoy both the creative and organisational sides of marketing. One day you may be designing a retailer brochure; another day you may be planning a product-launch calendar, selecting influencers or coordinating a brand collaboration.



We do not want someone who waits to be told exactly what to do at every stage. We are looking for someone who will research, propose ideas, prepare plans and then execute agreed activity to a high standard.



The Founder will continue to set the overall business priorities and approve key strategic decisions. You will help develop the detailed marketing plans and bring those priorities to life.



Working Arrangements

- Full-time remote position.

- 40 hours per week.

- Monday to Friday.

- You must be available for agreed crossover hours with the UK team.

- Long-term position for the right person.

- Starting salary of PHP 35,000–40,000 per month, depending on relevant experience, skills and portfolio.

- Performance and salary review following successful completion of the initial review period.



How to Apply



Please include all of the following:



- CV/resume.

- Portfolio link — with a note asking them to highlight 2–3 pieces they feel are most relevant to Baie Botanique.

- Brief summary of their social media/marketing experience, including influencers or launches if applicable.

- Current employment status + earliest start date.

- Expected monthly salary.

- Start the application with “Creative Brand Marketing.”





Applications without a portfolio or relevant design examples will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a practical paid assessment involving graphic design, campaign planning and marketing coordination.

Qualifications

 communication.

title: YouTube Script Writer for Educational Channel (Long-Form Videos)
description:
We teach people (mostly women aged 25 - 55) how to sell digital products on Etsy. We need someone who can turn a video outline into a full script that sounds like us and gets people to take action, not just watch.



—————————————



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Turn outlines into full scripts, with a strong hook, clear structure, and a clear payoff

- Write in our voice: simple, direct, and friendly, like a teacher, not a textbook

- Add clear calls to action throughout the script tied to our paid course

- Do some research to fill in real numbers, examples, or facts the outline does not cover

- Keep scripts easy to read out loud. We record straight from your script, so it must sound natural when spoken.

- Start with 7 scripts a month. Grow to 8 scripts a month.



—————————————



WHO THIS IS FOR

- You understand that a script’s job does not end when someone finishes watching. It should move them closer to buying.

- You have written YouTube scripts before, and you can show us the videos

- You understand hook writing as a skill

- You can write in someone else’s voice and tone, not just your own

- You have experience with, or real interest in, courses, coaching, or online business content. Etsy, e-commerce, or “make money online” videos are a big plus.

- You can take a short outline and turn it into a full script. You do not need every detail spelled out for you.

- You hit deadlines without being chased



Please DO NOT apply if:

- You have only written scripts for fun or entertainment channels, with no experience tying a script to a sale or a sign up

- You need a finished outline with every word planned out before you can write

- You cannot show us real scripts you have written



In short: we want a strong writer who can sound like us, hook a viewer fast, and never forget that the real goal is a sale, not just a view.



—————————————



PAY

$50 per script, covering 7 scripts per month. This matches typical entry-level rates for this kind of work. As we grow to 8+ scripts a month and this role proves its value, pay can grow too.



—————————————



HOW TO APPLY



Show Your Work

- Link 2 to 3 YouTube scripts you have written that did well. Tell us which parts were yours if you didn’t write the entire script.



- Start your application with “Turn Views Into Sales.” This tells us you read the whole post.



***If you contact us outside of this platform you will be AUTOMATICALLY DISQUALIFIED.



—————————————



MORE DETAILS

- Fully remote

- This can grow into a long-term role for the right person.

- A paid 30-day trial before any ongoing work

- Pay can grow as this role helps bring in more sales

title: Medico-legal Services Coordinator
description:
Overview



Encina Evaluation Services is hiring a direct, in-house Fulfillment Coordinator to take over report-production and fulfillment execution. This work is currently handled on an interim basis by a senior member of our team, who will train the new hire directly using the standard operating procedures built for this role. 



Key Responsibilities

Live phone coverage (triage and route, not resolve everything)

• Answer inbound calls live during business hours.

• Scheduling or billing requests: log the request and route to Pam (warm transfer if available, logged in Airtable/Front if not). This role does not make scheduling or billing decisions.

• Fulfillment-status questions (report status, deadlines, whether records have come in): answer directly — this is within the role's own domain.

• Anything unclear or a real evaluator concern/complaint: escalate to the appropriate owner rather than guessing.

Report production coordination

• Coordinate record collection and review with outside vendors, ensuring records arrive complete and on time.

• Track transcription requests through to completion; follow up proactively on delays.

• Coordinate medical history and self-history intake.

• Manage questionnaire distribution, collection, and tracking.

Deadline and compliance management

• Track report deadlines and extension requests per DWC/QME requirements.

• Ensure ex parte communication rules are followed in all evaluator and party correspondence.

• Flag and escalate common exceptions per the SOP rather than letting them stall silently.



Case tracking

• Maintain accurate, up-to-date case records in Airtable — status, ownership, next steps, and deadlines.

• Proactively surface at-risk cases (aging, missing documents, unresponsive parties) rather than waiting to be asked.



Working Hours

7:30am–3:30pm Pacific Time, core hours. This is a flexible, remote role — some room to shift within the window as needed, but consistent early coverage matters, since this window is designed to catch early-morning and overnight items (evaluator questions, scheduling issues) before the rest of the day gets going.

Training and Ramp-Up

• Trained directly by a senior team member currently handling this function, using the fulfillment SOP as the primary reference document.

• Shadow period covering live cases before taking over full ownership.

• Goal: full independence within [TBD] weeks, freeing Ver to shift focus to process oversight and continued documentation.



Requirements

• Strong written English; comfortable managing many open items simultaneously with minimal oversight.

• Detail-oriented, with a track record of following through rather than letting things sit.

• Experience with medical, legal, or workers' compensation administrative work preferred but not required.

• Comfortable working within a defined process (SOP-driven) while still flagging exceptions that don't fit it.

• Available for a defined full-time schedule aligned to US business hours (specific hours TBD).



What Success Looks Like

• Reports move through the full production pipeline without stalling or requiring evaluator escalation.

• Deadlines and extensions are tracked proactively, not reactively.

• Ver is able to step back from day-to-day execution once this person is ramped.



Compensation

$1,300–$1,500/month, full-time, salaried (flat monthly, not hourly) — flexible upward for a candidate with real medical/legal admin experience. Positioned below our senior process/coordination role, reflecting execution-against-SOP scope rather than process design.



What to Expect

• Start date: Sept 15

• Hours: Approximately 35–40 hours/week

• Compensation: $1,300–$1,500/month (contractor), flexible upward for relevant experience

• Reporting to: Founder & CEO (initially); transitioning to our senior fulfillment coordinator

• Location: Remote; Philippines-based candidates strongly preferred



To Apply

Please send the following to 

• Your resume or CV

• A brief note (3–5 sentences) describing a time you coordinated a multi-step process with several moving parts and deadlines — what was the situation, what did you own, and what was the outcome?

Applications without the brief note will not be reviewed.

title: Healthcare Onboarding Specialist

 9pm EST - 4pm EST

This is NOT an ENTRY Level Role. Do not APPLY if you do not have direct experience or intend to work multiple jobs at once during working hours. 



Position Overview



HomeLogic Healthcare is seeking a detail-oriented, highly organized, and dependable HR Associate (Onboarding & Compliance) to support the onboarding of nurses and caregivers while ensuring full regulatory compliance.



This role is critical to maintaining the integrity of our hiring processes and ensuring that all clinical staff meet required standards before working in client homes 



The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, highly organized, reliable, and thrives in a fast-paced healthcare environment where accuracy and accountability are non-negotiable.

-. Compliance & Credentialing

---

---



Compensation & Benefits

title: Hiring Solutions Outreach Specialist
description:
Position Summary



The Vantage Group is seeking a professional, organized, and persistent Hiring Solutions Outreach Specialist to connect with hiring professionals at automotive dealerships and related businesses throughout the United States.



This position requires 20 hours per week. Hours may be distributed flexibly based on business needs and mutual agreement, provided the required 20 hours are completed each week.



The role involves regular communication with U.S. business professionals. All outbound calls must be made during normal business hours (10 am to 4 pm, Monday -Friday) for the applicable United States operation and the prospect's local time zone. The Specialist must schedule calls according to the local time zone of each prospect and avoid calling outside reasonable business hours unless a specific alternative time has been requested or approved by the prospect.



Fluent English, strong verbal communication skills, and an understanding of U.S. business culture are required. Automotive dealership experience is a plus.



The primary responsibility is to identify hiring decision-makers, introduce Vantage's outsourced hiring support, build professional relationships, and schedule consultation meetings. This is a relationship-building and business development role—not high-pressure telemarketing.



What We Provide



The Vantage Group will provide:



Organized prospect lists with company, contact, and hiring information.

Approved call scripts and conversation guides.

Instructions for handling gatekeepers, objections, voi
s, follow-ups, and meeting scheduling.

Tools for recording call outcomes, conversation notes, follow-up dates, and meeting status.



The Outreach Specialist must keep all information accurate and updated after every interaction. Notes should be concise, factual, professional, and focused on the prospect's hiring needs, questions, objections, requested information, and agreed-upon next steps.



Primary Responsibilities

Make professional outbound calls to U.S. automotive dealerships and related businesses during normal business hours for the applicable U.S. operation and the prospect's local time zone.

Identify HR professionals, hiring managers, recruiters, or other decision-makers.

Explain Vantage's hiring-process support services.

Build rapport and secure qualified consultation meetings.

Conduct follow-up calls as needed during appropriate local business hours.

Research and verify contact information, including the prospect's location and time zone when necessary.

Maintain accurate Excel or CRM records.

Document every call attempt and update next steps.

Represent The Vantage Group professionally.

Complete assigned work within the agreed-upon 20-hour weekly schedule.

Schedule and Hourly Output Expectations



This is a 20-hour-per-week part-time position. The schedule may be arranged flexibly with The Vantage Group. All calling activity must be conducted during normal business hours for U.S. operations and must account for the local time zone of the prospect being contacted.



Performance will be measured based on hourly output and weekly results, not on a fixed number of calls per day.



Expected activity includes:



Approximately 5–8 documented call attempts per hour, depending on call length, research requirements, contact quality, follow-up needs, and documentation time.

Approximately 100–160 documented call attempts per 20-hour week, depending on the complexity of the assigned prospect list and the number of meaningful conversations.

Accurate documentation of 100% of call attempts and prospect interactions.

Completion of all required follow-up actions within the agreed-upon timeframe and during appropriate business hours for the prospect's local time zone.

Timely research and verification of contact information.

Consistent progress toward qualified consultation meetings.



The hourly call-output range is a planning guideline, not a requirement to rush conversations or sacrifice quality. A longer conversation with a decision-maker, detailed research, accurate documentation, or a qualified meeting opportunity may appropriately reduce the number of calls completed during that hour.



Performance will be evaluated using a balanced combination of:



Documented call attempts per hour.

Total documented activity during the 20-hour workweek.

Quality and accuracy of contact research.

Meaningful conversations with qualified contacts.

Proper handling of objections and follow-up commitments.

Accurate and complete records.

Qualified consultation meetings scheduled.

Reliability in completing the full 20-hour weekly commitment.

Compliance with appropriate calling hours for each prospect's local time zone.

Qualifications

Fluent English with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong understanding of U.S. business culture.

Professional and confident telephone presence.

Comfortable speaking with gatekeepers and decision-makers.

Persistent, organized, and detail-oriented.

Proficient with Microsoft Excel and standard business applications.

Comfortable conducting online research.

Able to document conversations accurately.

CRM experience is a plus.

Automotive dealership or hiring experience is preferred.

Able to work independently and reliably complete 20 hours per week.

Able to schedule and conduct calls during normal business hours for U.S. operations while accounting for each prospect's local time zone.

Able to maintain consistent hourly productivity while prioritizing professionalism, accuracy, and relationship quality.

What Success Looks Like



Success means consistently identifying the right hiring contact, creating qualified opportunities, documenting conversations accurately, following up as promised, and scheduling consultation meetings while completing the agreed-upon 20 hours each week.



The objective is simple: use each working hour productively, find the right person, create the opportunity, document the conversation, follow through, and secure qualified meetings within a reliable 20-hour-per-week schedule while making calls during appropriate business hours for each prospect's local time zone.

title: Grant Writer & Grants Coordinator
description:
Grant Writer & Grants Coordinator

The Beacon Center | Remote | Full-Time or Part-Time



About The Beacon Center



The Beacon Center is a community-based nonprofit organization in Montgomery, Alabama, focused on expanding access to services that help individuals and families thrive.



Our work includes behavioral health and counseling, healthcare access and health literacy, food security, workforce development, adult education, homelessness services, violence intervention, reentry support, community partnerships, and other initiatives designed to address social determinants of health.



As The Beacon Center continues to grow, we are seeking a highly organized and skilled Grant Writer & Grants Coordinator to help identify funding opportunities, develop competitive proposals, manage grant deadlines, and strengthen our overall grants pipeline.



Position Overview



This is not simply a writing position.



We are looking for someone who can help build and manage a strong grant development system for The Beacon Center.



The ideal candidate will be able to research funding opportunities, understand complex grant requirements, develop compelling proposals, organize supporting documents, maintain deadlines, communicate what information is needed from leadership and program staff, and assist with post-award reporting.



You should be comfortable working with U.S.-based foundations, corporations, government agencies, healthcare organizations, and philanthropic funders.



Primary Responsibilities



Grant Research



Research foundation, corporate, local, state, federal, healthcare, and community funding opportunities.



Identify grants that align with The Beacon Center’s programs and strategic priorities.



Review eligibility requirements before recommending opportunities.



Maintain a pipeline of upcoming grant opportunities.



Provide brief summaries of recommended grants, including funding amount, deadline, eligibility, program alignment, required documents, match requirements if applicable, and a recommendation on whether we should pursue the opportunity.



Grant Writing



Draft letters of inquiry and full grant proposals.



Develop compelling organizational narratives.



Write needs statements, program descriptions, goals, objectives, outcomes, sustainability plans, evaluation sections, and organizational capacity statements.



Adapt existing organizational information for different funders rather than starting from scratch each time.



Ensure proposals clearly respond to the funder’s questions and scoring criteria.



Assist with grant budgets and budget narratives in coordination with leadership and finance staff.



Proofread and edit proposals before submission.



Grant Management



Maintain a centralized grant calendar.



Track application deadlines, reporting deadlines, award notifications, renewals, and follow-up dates.



Maintain organized grant folders and supporting documentation.



Create checklists for each application.



Notify leadership early when documents, signatures, budgets, data, or partner information are needed.



Maintain updated versions of commonly requested organizational documents.



Grant Reporting



Help prepare interim and final grant reports.



Track required outcomes and reporting requirements.



Work with program staff to collect program data and success stories.



Assist in maintaining documentation required by funders.



Help ensure grant commitments and reporting deadlines are not missed.



Funding Areas



The Beacon Center pursues funding related to:



Behavioral health and counseling



Mental health access



HIV prevention and healthcare access



Social determinants of health



Community health workers



Health literacy



Food insecurity



Homelessness



Housing stability



Workforce development



Adult education and GED programs



Violence prevention and intervention



Hospital-based violence intervention



Reentry and justice-involved populations



Youth and family services



Faith and community partnerships



Community development



Capital improvements and facility development



Technology and program infrastructure



Required Qualifications



We are looking for someone with demonstrated experience, not someone learning grant writing for the first time.



Applicants should have:



At least 2 to 3 years of professional grant writing, nonprofit development, proposal writing, or related experience



Excellent written English



Strong research skills



Experience writing professional proposals, reports, or funding requests



Ability to understand detailed Requests for Proposals



Strong attention to detail



Excellent organization and deadline management



Ability to manage several grants simultaneously



Strong Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Drive skills



Ability to work independently



Ability to communicate clearly when information is missing

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Beauty & Personal Brand Content
description:
Position: Part-Time / Freelance with Opportunity for Long-Term Work

Content: Instagram Reels, TikTok & Short-Form Social Media

Location: Remote

Niche: Beauty, Esthetics, Education, Entrepreneurship & Lifestyle



About the Role



I’m looking for a creative, reliable short-form video editor who can help me turn raw footage into engaging, polished and scroll-stopping social media content.



I am a beauty business owner, esthetician, educator and content creator. My content ranges from educational beauty and waxing videos to behind-the-scenes business content, lifestyle videos, voiceovers and personal-brand content.



I already have an established style and brand. I’m looking for someone who can learn that style and eventually edit content with minimal direction.



This is NOT just about cutting clips together.



I want an editor who understands:



• Storytelling

• Strong hooks

• Viewer retention

• Short-form pacing

• Instagram & TikTok trends

• Clean text and captions

• Music and sound effects

• B-roll placement

• Beauty/lifestyle aesthetics

• When an edit should be simple vs. fast-paced



What You’ll Do



You will receive raw video footage, and depending on the project, I may also provide a script, voiceover, inspiration video or general direction.



Your job will be to turn that footage into finished short-form content ready to post.



Typical videos will include:



• Instagram Reels

• TikToks

• Educational talking-head videos

• Beauty/waxing tutorials

• Behind-the-scenes content

• Day-in-the-life videos

• Voiceover Reels

• Product/brand collaborations

• Lifestyle content

• Promotional videos



Most videos will be approximately 15–90 seconds.



Editing Style



My style is feminine, clean, modern and polished while still feeling natural and relatable.



I don’t want every video overly edited.



Some videos may need trendy, fast-paced editing while others should feel simple, luxurious and effortless.



You must be comfortable studying reference videos and recreating the overall editing style WITHOUT copying someone else’s work exactly.



Requirements



You should have:



• Experience editing Reels/TikToks/Shorts

• Strong English comprehension

• Excellent attention to detail

• Understanding of social-media retention

• Experience with captions/text animation

• Good music selection

• Good storytelling instincts

• Ability to follow creative direction

• Reliable communication

• Ability to meet deadlines

• Willingness to receive feedback and make revisions



Experience editing beauty, wellness, fashion, lifestyle, personal-brand or creator content is a BIG plus.



CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve are all acceptable.



Potential Workload



We will begin with a smaller number of videos while we learn how we work together.



If we’re a good fit, I would like this to develop into an ongoing relationship with approximately:



12–30+ short-form videos per month.



There is potential for the role and compensation to grow over time.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your location/time zone.

3. Your portfolio.

4. 3 examples of short-form videos YOU edited.

5. Your preferred editing software.

6. Your rate per short-form video OR preferred monthly rate for approximately 20 videos.

7. Typical turnaround time for one Reel.

8. Tell me about any experience you have editing beauty, lifestyle, educational or personal-brand content.



IMPORTANT: At the very end of your application, write the word PINK.



Applications that don’t include PINK will not be considered.



This helps me know that you actually read the entire job description.



Paid Editing Test



Selected finalists will be invited to complete a PAID test edit using the same raw footage.



You’ll receive reference videos showing the style I’m looking for.



I’m not looking for someone who can simply follow instructions—I want to find someone who understands the brand, has creative instincts and can eventually become a long-term part of my content team.

title: LinkedIn Outreach & Lead Generation Specialist
description:
VA Brief: LinkedIn Outreach & Strategy Specialist (Part-Time, 10-15 hrs/week)

About us: We're a property buyer's agency helping professionals and investors build wealth through property. LinkedIn is one of our primary channels for finding new clients. We offer a range of property services, including residential and commercial property acquisition, property development, property assessment and due diligence, auction and negotiation representation, purchase support, and portfolio reviews.

The goal: Get the contact off LinkedIn and into our database (ActiveCampaign). Every activity on LinkedIn exists to serve that one outcome.

What you'll do

1. Build and manage our Sales Navigator lead lists: set up saved searches, refine filters, and identify the right targeting criteria for our ideal client

2. Contribute to outreach strategy. Help shape targeting, messaging angles, and sequencing based on what's actually working, not just execute a fixed script

3. Send connection requests and early messages using our templates where appropriate. These cover the common, repeatable parts of the conversation

4. Personalise where it matters. Know when a templated message won't work and write something tailored instead; this will be a mix of both.

5. Have the ability to hold real conversations once someone engages. Natural, not scripted line-by-line

6. Once there's genuine interest and the prospect has agreed to hear from us, confirm what they've agreed to and obtain their verified contact details (using Apollo or similar). This flows into ActiveCampaign with the correct tag, completing the handoff

7. Log everything in our tracker (connections, conversation stage, outcome, consent captured,
 captured)

8. Maintain list hygiene. Withdraw stale pending requests, refresh saved searches as needed

9. Proactively flag what's working and what isn't, and suggest improvements to our targeting, messaging, or tools as you learn the system

Must-have requirements

• Highly experienced in B2B LinkedIn outreach. Able to show real examples of lists they've built and campaigns/conversations they've run

• Excellent written English. Non-negotiable given the calibre of our audience. Messages must not read as ChatGPT/AI-generated

• Strong personalisation skills. Comfortable blending templated messaging with bespoke responses depending on the conversation

• Experienced with Google Sheets or Excel. This is how we track everything, so comfort building/maintaining a structured tracker is essential

• Confident working independently, bringing strategic input, and suggesting improvements to how we run lead generation, not just executing tasks

• Confident using tools like Apollo (or similar) for contact enrichment, and comfortable suggesting improvements to how we run our lead generation system we want someone who brings ideas, not just executes tasks

Nice-to-have

• Experience with ActiveCampaign

What you must NOT do

• No bots, automation tools, or scraping software. Everything sent manually through LinkedIn/Sales Navigator

• Don't ask for an
 or pitch anything until there's a genuine signal of interest

• Don't use any tool to bulk-source or upload contacts who haven't had a genuine LinkedIn conversation and agreed to hear from us

Tools you'll access

• LinkedIn/Sales Navigator

• Apollo (or similar) for contact enrichment

• Our tracker (Google Sheets/Excel)

• Our tone/voice guidelines and message templates

KPIs we'll track weekly

• Quality of lead lists built

• Connection requests sent + acceptance rate

• Conversations that reached genuine engagement

•
s captured / contacts added to ActiveCampaign. This is the core success metric

Pay/experience level

Specialist role, not entry-level VA work. Candidates must be able to show examples/portfolio/case study of a B2B LinkedIn campaign they've personally run, including results.

title: SENIOR SEO SPECIALIST
description:
About Digital Trek



Digital Trek is a performance-focused digital marketing agency working primarily with home service and local businesses across Canada and the United States.



We help businesses grow through SEO, Google Ads, website development, content marketing, local SEO, conversion optimization, and AI-powered marketing tools.



We are looking for an SEO Specialist who can take ownership of the day-to-day SEO execution across multiple client accounts.



The Role



As our SEO Specialist, you will be responsible for implementing and managing SEO strategies designed to increase organic visibility, qualified website traffic, and leads.



This is a hands-on role.



You should be comfortable auditing websites, researching keywords, optimizing pages, planning content, working with WordPress, improving Google Business Profiles, monitoring rankings, and identifying technical SEO problems.



You will work closely with our strategy, content, development, and paid advertising teams.



Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Research

Improve H1-H6 heading structure

Optimize existing website copy

Improve internal linking

Optimize URLs and page structure

Optimize images, alt text, and supporting page elements

Implement relevant schema markup

Prevent keyword cannibalization

Technical SEO

Perform regular technical SEO audits

Monitor indexing and crawlability

Identify broken links, redirects, duplicate content, and 404 errors

Review XML sitemaps and robots.txt

Monitor Core Web Vitals and website performance

Identify issues affecting organic rankings

Work with developers to resolve technical problems

Content & Topical Authority

Build monthly SEO content plans

Research topics based on search intent

Create detailed article briefs

Optimize AI-assisted and human-written content

Build topic clusters around priority services

Connect supporting articles to commercial service pages

Update older content when opportunities are identified

Local SEO

Optimize Google Business Profiles

Research local keywords

Optimize location and service-area pages

Manage citation consistency

Identify local backlink opportunities

Monitor local rankings and competitors

Link Building & Authority

Identify relevant backlink opportunities

Support outreach and digital PR initiatives

Review backlink profiles

Monitor potentially harmful links

Build relationships with relevant local and industry websites

Tracking & Reporting

Monitor rankings, traffic, conversions, and leads

Use Google Search Console and GA4 to identify opportunities

Track SEO performance against client goals

Maintain SEO tracking documents

Prepare monthly SEO reporting

Explain what improved, what declined, why it happened, and what should happen next

Tools You Should Know



Experience with several of the following is expected:



Google Search Console

Google Analytics 4

Google Business Profile

SEMrush

Screaming Frog

WordPress

Rank Math or similar SEO plugins

Google Sheets

Looker Studio

AI tools such as ChatGPT

What We Are Looking For

2+ years of hands-on SEO experience

Strong understanding of technical, on-page, content, and local SEO

Experience working with local businesses

Strong keyword research skills

Comfortable working inside WordPress

Strong attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple client websites

Good written English

Ability to work independently

Comfortable using AI to improve productivity without sacrificing quality



Agency experience is strongly preferred.



Experience with roofing, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, pest control, painting, construction, or other home-service businesses is a major advantage.



What Success Looks Like



You will not be evaluated simply on rankings or the number of tasks completed.



Success means:



Growing qualified organic traffic

Increasing leads from organic search

Improving visibility for commercially valuable keywords

Increasing local search visibility

Publishing and improving high-quality SEO content

Identifying SEO problems before clients notice them

Completing work accurately and on schedule

Continuously finding new opportunities for client growth

The Person We Want



We are looking for someone who takes ownership.



If you notice an indexing problem, you investigate it.



If a page loses rankings, you try to understand why.



If competitors are outperforming us, you research what they are doing differently.



If you see an opportunity, you bring it forward.



We value people who think critically, communicate clearly, and focus on measurable business results rather than simply checking SEO tasks off a list.

title: Recruitment Delivery Manager — US Direct-Hire Staffing — Night Shift, Remote
description:
US-based direct-hire staffing firm (healthcare/allied-health core, expanding into new verticals) is hiring a Recruitment Delivery Manager — a player-coach who owns our open-job board end-to-end and is accountable for filling it. Fully remote, Philippines-based, reporting directly to the founder.



This is not a sourcing-team or coordinator seat. You take the list of open US jobs, build the fill strategy for each one (sourcing channels, candidate pool, pay-band reality, timeline), personally recruit on the priority searches — sourcing, screening, and submitting candidates yourself — and build and coach a small delivery team as volume grows. You own the number: qualified submittals per week and jobs filled.



Responsibilities

- Own the open-req board: triage every US job, build a written per-req fill strategy, and keep every req moving or call it honestly.

- Personally work the priority desks full-cycle: source, screen (live phone/video), prep, and submit qualified candidates to US clients.

- Drive the delivery standard — quality-gated submittals per recruiter per week — with every candidate recruiter-screened before submission, no resume-blasting.

- Recruit, onboard, and coach delivery recruiters as the board requires; run the daily delivery cadence and report fill metrics weekly to the founder.

- Tell the truth with numbers: pipeline, submittals, interviews, offers, fills — measured, never estimated.



Required

- 4+ years US staffing/recruiting delivery experience, including 2+ years leading a delivery team that was measured on submittals and placements (not a sourcing-only or admin team). US healthcare staffing strongly preferred; allied health/imaging a major plus.

- Placements you personally closed — you can name specific placements you made (role, US state, salary) and walk through how you filled them. There WILL be a detailed walkthrough on the interview.

- Tenure that holds: at least one 24+ month run at a single staffing employer.

- Excellent spoken English — you screen candidates by phone and coach people who do; there will be a live spoken check.

- Fluent with an ATS and modern sourcing (job boards, LinkedIn, licensure/credential basics for US healthcare roles).

- Can work the fixed US night shift long-term with a reliable home setup (quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data).



**Do NOT apply if:** your leadership experience is sourcing/CV-mining teams only (you've never owned submittals-to-fill); you've only coordinated VMS portals or onboarding paperwork; you cannot name specific placements you personally closed; your spoken English isn't strong enough to screen US healthcare professionals; or you can't commit to the fixed US night shift.



Why us: you run the whole delivery engine, not a slice of it — direct line to the founder, real authority over strategy and (as volume grows) your own team, competitive base plus a placement-linked bonus so your fills pay you, fully remote, long-term.



## APPLICATION QUESTIONS



1. The delivery team you led: company, your title, team headcount, what the team was measured on, and its typical submittals + placements per month. What part did you personally still recruit on?

2. Name ONE placement you PERSONALLY closed in the last 2 years — job title, US state, salary, and how you found the candidate. *(Most important question — real specifics; we verify on the call.)*

3. Your longest single tenure at one staffing employer: company + number of months.

4. A US client gives you a hard-to-fill job: CT Technologist in Colorado, 9 candidates already submitted by others, none hired. In 4–6 sentences: your fill strategy, step by step.

5. Can you commit to a FIXED US night shift (~9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT), Mon–Fri, long-term? (Yes/No + any constraint) And your home setup: internet speed, headset, quiet room, backup power/internet?

6. Current/most-recent monthly pay (PHP or USD), earliest start date, and a **30–60 sec voice intro** (link) introducing yourself as if opening a screening call with a US radiologic technologist.

description:
We’re Hiring: People & Culture Operations Specialist

100% Remote | Full-Time

Working closely with the Head of People & Culture, you will help ensure that employee records, HR systems, payroll-related updates, recruitment coordination, training requirements, leave administration, and other People & Culture activities are handled accurately and on time.

-Updating employee profiles and employment information.

-Managing employee leave and time-off records.

-Assisting employees and managers with routine BambooHR-related questions.

-Looking for ways to make better use of BambooHR and reduce unnecessary manual HR processes.

-Establishing and maintaining clear procedures for HRIS administration.

-BambooHR experience is highly preferred. Candidates who have administered another HRIS may also be considered if they have strong relevant experience and can quickly adapt to new systems.



Payroll Coordination

-Support payroll administration for employees in the United States and United Kingdom by:

-Preparing and reviewing employee updates that affect payroll.

-Processing salary increases, promotions, bonuses, and other compensation updates.

Previous experience supporting U.S. and/or UK payroll administration is strongly preferred.

-Leave & Time-Off Support

-Keep leave-related records, documentation, correspondence, and dates accurate within the HRIS.

-Ensure required approvals and documentation are collected and properly maintained.

-Monitor key leave dates and follow up on outstanding requirements.

-Administer company time-off policies through BambooHR.

-Respond to routine employee questions concerning leave and time-off procedures.

-Escalate complex leave, legal, or employee-relations concerns to the Head of People & Culture.

-Apply leave and time-off procedures consistently according to company policies.



Recruitment Coordination

Provide administrative support across the hiring process, including:

-Arranging interviews across different time zones.

-Coordinating candidate availability with hiring teams.

-Keeping candidate information and recruitment activities updated in the ATS.

-Managing candidate communications during the recruitment process.

-Coordinating interview schedules and following up with interviewers.

-Preparing offer documentation and assisting with the candidate-to-employee transition.

-Coordinating pre-employment and onboarding requirements.

-Maintaining recruitment trackers and monitoring candidate progress.

-Supporting the Head of People & Culture and hiring managers with additional recruitment-related activities.



Training & Compliance

-Manage administrative activities within the company’s employee training platform.

-Assign required training to employees.

-Monitor completion of mandatory and role-specific training.

-Follow up on incomplete training requirements.

-Maintain training records and completion reports.

-Assist with implementing new policies, procedures, and required employee acknowledgements.

-Maintain documentation related to policy acknowledgements and other required records.

-Support compliance monitoring and reporting activities.

-People & Culture Support



The People & Culture inbox will be an important part of your day-to-day responsibilities.

You will:

-Monitor incoming employee and manager requests.

-Ensure questions and requests receive timely responses.

-Handle routine HR and policy-related inquiries when appropriate.

-Direct matters to the appropriate People & Culture team member or internal stakeholder.

-Monitor open requests until they are fully resolved.

-Follow up with employees, managers, or stakeholders when additional information or action is needed.

-Recognize urgent, sensitive, or complex matters and escalate them promptly.

Ability to work comfortably with spreadsheets, electronic employee records, and data reports.

title: Medical Virtual Assistant / Patient Coordinator – Excellent English + Sales Required
description:
# Virtual Medical Assistant / Patient Coordinator – MedSpa



We are a growing medical aesthetics and wellness practice in Texas looking for an exceptional **Virtual Medical Assistant / Patient Coordinator** to join our team long-term.



This is **NOT simply an administrative VA position.**



You will often be the **first person our potential patients speak with**, so your ability to communicate, build trust, provide outstanding customer service, and convert inquiries into booked appointments is extremely important.



We are looking for someone who is **warm, confident, highly organized, proactive, and sales-minded**.



## Your Responsibilities



* Answer incoming patient phone calls

* Respond to text messages and patient inquiries

* Follow up with new leads

* Convert inquiries into booked consultations and treatments

* Schedule and reschedule appointments

* Follow up with patients after consultations and treatments

* Re-engage leads who did not initially book

* Explain basic information about our aesthetic and wellness services

* Communicate professionally and warmly with patients

* Maintain accurate patient information

* Assist with EMR/CRM and administrative tasks

* Help ensure that no lead or patient inquiry is forgotten

* Provide an excellent, high-end customer experience



Our services include:



* Botox and neurotoxins

* Dermal fillers

* Skin treatments

* Laser treatments

* Medical weight loss / GLP-1 programs

* Hormone replacement therapy

* Peptides and wellness treatments



You do **not** need to know everything about these treatments before starting. We can train the right person.



## What We Care About Most



### 1. Excellent Spoken English



You must be comfortable speaking with American patients on the phone.



Your English should be clear, natural, professional, and easy to understand.



### 2. Excellent Customer Service



We want someone who genuinely enjoys talking with people and knows how to make patients feel welcomed, valued, and taken care of.



### 3. Sales Ability



You should understand that when a potential patient contacts us, your job is not simply to answer their question and end the conversation.



Your goal is to:



**Build trust → understand what they want → answer their concerns → recommend the next step → book the appointment.**



You should be comfortable following up with leads and asking for the appointment.



### 4. Confidence



You cannot be afraid of the phone.



We need someone who can confidently guide conversations rather than simply waiting for the patient to tell them what to do.



### 5. Reliability



We are looking for someone who wants a **long-term position**, takes ownership of their responsibilities, follows through, and does not require constant supervision.



## Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is a plus:



* Medical assistant

* Nurse or healthcare professional

* Medical virtual assistant

* Dental office

* MedSpa / aesthetics

* Plastic surgery

* Dermatology

* Patient coordinator

* Receptionist

* Customer service

* Appointment setting

* Sales

* Lead conversion



Healthcare experience is helpful, but **excellent communication, customer service, and sales ability are more important than having the perfect medical background.**



## How to Apply — VIDEO REQUIRED



**Do not send only a resume.**



To be considered, you MUST send a **2–3 minute video introduction**.



In your video, please answer:



1. Introduce yourself and briefly explain your professional background.

2. Why do you think you would be good at speaking with MedSpa patients?

3. Tell us about your customer service or sales experience.

4. Tell us about a time you successfully convinced a customer or patient to move forward with a purchase, appointment, or service.

5. Pretend you received this phone call:



> “Hi, I'm interested in Botox, but I'm just calling around to compare prices.”



Show us how you would respond and try to turn this caller into a booked consultation or appointment.



**Please speak naturally. Do not read your answers from a script.**



Your video is one of the most important parts of the application because this position requires frequent communication with patients.



Applications without a video will not be considered.



## In Your Written Application, Include:



* Your resume

* Your expected hourly rate

* Your availability

* Your timezone

* Your healthcare experience, if applicable

* Your customer service experience

* Your sales experience

* A link to your video introduction

* The word **“VIBE”** at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire job posting



## Schedule



We are looking for someone interested in a consistent, long-term position who can work during **U.S. Central Time business hours**.



## Who Will Succeed in This Role



You will probably love this position if you:



* Love talking with people

* Are naturally friendly and personable

* Enjoy sales and achieving goals

* Are comfortable following up multiple times

* Are highly organized

* Learn quickly

* Take initiative

* Pay attention to details

* Want to grow with one company instead of constantly changing clients



We are building a growing practice and are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of the team.



If you are looking for a position where you can simply complete tasks quietly in the background, **this is probably not the right position for you.**



If you are confident, personable, competitive, organized, and enjoy turning conversations into happy patients and booked appointments, we would love to hear from you.

description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME ANDA VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator 



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour break

Salary: TBD



Job Overview: 

We are seeking an experienced Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator to support our U.S.-based estimating team. This role is responsible for reviewing construction documents, performing detailed quantity takeoffs, identifying scope requirements, and preparing accurate rough carpentry estimates for commercial, multifamily, educational, prevailing wage, and other construction projects.



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of wood framing construction and can independently interpret architectural and structural plans, specifications, details, sections, schedules, and general notes. Accuracy, attention to detail, organization, and clear communication are essential, particularly when identifying missing, conflicting, or unclear information.



Key Responsibilities:

Plan & Specification Review

* Review architectural, structural, and applicable civil plans.

* Review project specifications and identify requirements affecting the rough carpentry scope.

* Interpret plans, details, sections, schedules, and general notes.

* Identify discrepancies between architectural and structural drawings.

* Identify missing information and items requiring clarification or RFI.

* Review addenda, bulletins, RFIs, and revised drawings and determine their impact on the estimate.



Quantity Takeoffs

* Prepare detailed quantity takeoffs for rough carpentry materials and labor, including:

* Dimensional lumber, wall framing, wood stud walls, and interior/exterior framing

* Floor and roof framing, roof/floor/wall sheathing, plywood, and OSB

* Blocking and backing, miscellaneous wood framing, pressure-treated lumber, sill plates, and ledgers

* Posts and beams, glulam beams, LVL, and engineered wood products

* Hardware and connectors, including hold-downs, straps, clips, hangers, anchor bolts, and fastening requirements

* Trusses, roof/floor truss-related scope, and miscellaneous rough carpentry materials

* Clearly identify quantities by building, floor, area, and material type whenever applicable.



Labor Estimating

* Assist with developing labor quantities based on takeoff information.

* Understand the relationship between material quantities and field installation.

* Identify conditions that may increase labor requirements.

* Consider difficult access, height, phasing, sequencing, and other project conditions that may affect productivity.

* Identify prevailing wage or other labor requirements shown in the bid documents.



Scope Review

* Develop a thorough understanding of the complete rough carpentry scope and identify items that may be missed during a standard material takeoff.

* Review scope responsibilities and general contractor requirements.

* Account for temporary construction, equipment, hoisting, material handling, cleanup, protection, and layout.

* Identify blocking and backing, fire-treated, and pressure-treated lumber requirements.

* Review special inspection, engineering, and deferred submittal requirements.

* Coordinate rough carpentry scope with structural steel, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other trades.



Estimate Preparation

* Organize takeoffs in accordance with company estimating standards.

* Enter quantities accurately into company estimating software and templates.

* Maintain clear supporting documentation for all quantities.

* Clearly document assumptions, exclusions, and clarifications.

* Identify potential cost risks before the estimate is finalized.

* Compare estimates against historical information when available.

* Assist the lead estimator in preparing the final proposal.



Quality Control

* Perform a complete self-review of the takeoff and verify quantities against plans.

* Confirm all buildings and areas have been included.

* Review architectural quantities against structural requirements.

* Confirm plan revisions and addenda have been incorporated.

* Verify that major material quantities are reasonable.

* Check for duplicated or missing scope.

* Clearly identify questionable conditions rather than making unsupported assumptions.

* Maintain organized takeoff files so they can be easily reviewed by another estimator.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Previous experience estimating rough carpentry, wood framing, or wood-frame construction

* Strong ability to read and interpret architectural and structural construction documents

* Experience performing detailed construction quantity takeoffs

* Strong understanding of wood framing systems and construction sequencing

* Familiarity with lumber, plywood, OSB, engineered wood products, trusses, hardware, and connectors

* Strong mathematical, analytical, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills

* Ability to manage multiple estimates and meet assigned deadlines

* Strong ability to identify scope gaps, discrepancies, and unusual project conditions

* Ability to clearly communicate questions, assumptions, and potential problems

* Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a U.S.-based estimating team

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills

* Bluebeam Revu experience preferred

* Experience with On-Screen Takeoff or similar takeoff software preferred

* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Teams

* Experience with construction estimating software and PDF plan/specification management systems is a plus

* Willingness to ask questions and seek clarification rather than make unsupported assumptions

* Able to work during agreed-upon overlapping hours with the U.S.-based team



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.
